v: Ayik te icham winakxo winhaj rey David, te si'ikxo syab' winh. Wach'chom te pim tz'ajk'e sk'u' winh, palta maxtzak k'ixnajlaj winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal heb' tz'ak'an serwil winh icha tik: Smoj wal saychaj junok ix kob'es tz'ilan winh, sway ix t'a stz'ey winh yik sk'ixnaj jab'okxo sniwanil winh, xchi heb'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at sayumal jun ix kob'es te wach' yilji t'a masanil yol yik Israel. Ix ilchaj jun ix yuj heb' t'a chonhab' Sunem, Abisag sb'i ix, ix ik'jikot ix t'a winhaj rey David chi'.
Te wach' yilji ix. Ha ix stanhwan winhaj rey David chi', swaypax ix yet' winh, palta malaj junelok ay tas ix sk'ulej winh yet' ix.

Haxo winhaj Adonías yuninal winhaj David yet' ix Haguit, ix yak'och sb'a winh reyal yalani. Ix yik'an juntzanh carruaje winh yet' heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' 50 heb' soldado tzek' yet' winh.

Yiktax ix k'ib' winh, malaj junelok ix kachji winh yuj winh smam chi', maj sk'anb'ej winh smam winh chi' t'ay junelok tas sk'ulej. Te wach' yilji winhaj Adonías chi', b'ab'el ix ajkan winh t'a skal heb' yuninal winhaj David chi' ayik ix cham winhaj Absalón.
Ha winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia yet' winhaj sacerdote Abiatar ix yak'och sb'a heb' winh yet' winhaj Adonías chi', yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej srazón winh t'a heb' winh.

Haxo pax winhaj sacerdote Sadoc, winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, winhaj Natán schekab' Dios, winhaj Simei, winhaj Rei yet' heb' soldado stanhwan winhaj rey David chi', maj ochlaj heb' winh yet' winhaj Adonías chi'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ix sb'o jun niwan wa'el winhaj Adonías chi' t'a yich jun k'e'en k'e'en skuch Zohelet t'a slak'anil b'aj sk'eul sjaj ha ha' t'a Rogel. Tzijtum nok' kalnel, nok' mam wakax yet' nok' kelemtak wakax b'ak'ech ix yak' winh silab'il. Ix yawtan heb' yuk'tak winh, heb' yuninal winhaj rey David chi'. Ix yawtanpax masanil heb' aj Judá winh, haton heb' smunlaj yet' winh rey chi'.
Palta haxo winhaj Natán schekab' Dios, maj awtajlaj winh yuj winh. Maj yawtejpaxlaj winhaj Benaía winh yet' heb' soldado stanhwan winhaj rey David chi', ma winhaj Salomón yuk'tak winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Natán chi' yal t'a ix Betsabé snun winhaj Salomón chi', ix yalan winh: --¿Tom manto ab'i to toxo ix yak'och sb'a winhaj Adonías reyal t'a elk'altak? Palta manh yojtakokpax winhaj rey David.
Ha tiknaik, cha ab' tas ol wal t'ayach yik wach' manh ol ach cham yet' winh une' aj Salomón tik.

Ixik t'a winhaj rey David chi', tzalan t'a winh: Mamin rey, alnakxokan t'ayin to a winh wune' aj Salomón ol ochkan reyal a k'exulok, a winh ol ochkan t'a yol a despacho. ¿Tas yuj a winhaj Adonías ix yak'och sb'a reyal? xa chi.
Ayik wan a lolon yet' winh rey chi' ol in ochk'ochok. Ha inxo ol wala' to yelton tas tzal chi', xchi winhaj Natán chi' t'a ix.
Yuj chi', ix b'at ix Betsabé chi' yil winhaj rey David b'aj ayek' chi'. Te icham winakxo winh. Ha ix Abisag sunamita tz'ilan winh.
Ayik ix k'och ix Betsabé chi' t'a yichanh winh, ix em nhojan ix yak'an stzatzil sk'ol winh, ix yalan winh t'a ix: --¿Tas tza nib'ej? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi ix: --Wal t'a sb'i Jehová ix ala' to a winh wune' aj Salomón ol ochkan a k'exulok t'a reyal. Ha winh ol ochkan t'a yol a despacho.
Palta ina toxo ix yak'och sb'a winhaj Adonías reyal, a hachxo tik mamin rey, manh ojtakok yaji.

Tzijtum nok' kalnel, nok' mam wakax yet' nok' kelemtak wakax b'ak'ech ix yak' winh silab'il. Ix yawtej heb' uninal winh yet' winhaj sacerdote Abiatar, winhaj Joab yajalil heb' a soldado t'a jun wa'el ix sb'o winh chi', palta maj yawtejlaj winh uninal aj Salomón winh.
Yuj chi', wan stanhwan masanil heb' chonhab' israel tas xa chi, mach ol ak'kanoch reyal a k'exulok.
Palta tato max a b'okan yaj jun tik, haxo yik toxo ix ach chami, axom in miljicham yet' winh wune' aj Salomón chi', xchi ix.
Wanto wal slolon ix yet' winh rey chi', ix ja winhaj Natán schekab' Dios.
Ix alchaj yab' winhaj rey David chi' to toxo ix jawi winhaj Natán chi', ix awtajoch winh, ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh rey chi': --¿Tom a ach ix ala' to tz'ochkan winhaj Adonías reyal a k'exulok?

Ina tiknaik tzijtum nok' kalnel toxo ix smilcham winh yet' nok' mam wakax yet' nok' kelemtak wakax te b'ak'ech silab'il. Ix yawtan heb' winh uninal winh yet' masanil heb' winh ayoch yajalilok heb' a soldado yet' winhaj sacerdote Abiatar. Ha tiknaik wan swa heb' winh smasanil, tz'el yaw heb': Niwanokab' yelk'och winhaj rey Adonías, xchi heb' winh.
Ha inxo tik maj in yawtejlaj winh yet' winhaj sacerdote Sadoc. Maj yawtejpax winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada winh, maj awtajlajpax winh uninal aj Salomón.
¿Tom a ch'okojnhej tza b'ok'e jun tik? ¿Tom maj al t'ayonh, mach ol ochkan reyal a k'exulok chi'? xchi winhaj Natán chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj rey David to tz'awtajxikot ix Betsabé. Ayik ix k'och ix t'a yichanh winh rey chi',
ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Swak' in ti' t'a Jehová, haton ix in tanhwan t'a skal in ya'elal
to a tiknaik ol wak'elk'och tas ix wal t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal, a winh une' aj Salomón ol ochkan t'a in despacho tik in k'exulok, xchi winh.
Ixnhej yab' ix Betsabé chi' icha chi', ix em nhojnaj ix t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan ix: --Mamin rey, ayachnhejokab' ek' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi ix.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' to tz'awtaj winhaj sacerdote Sadoc yet' winhaj Natán schekab' Dios yet' pax winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada. Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi',
ix yalan winh: --Ik'ekb'at jaywanh heb' winh ayoch yajalil wet'ok, tzeyak'ank'e winh wuninal aj Salomón t'a yib'anh nok' in mula tzin k'e t'a yib'anh, tzeyik'anb'at winh t'a sjaj ha' Gihón.

Ach sacerdote Sadoc yet' ach Natán, tzeyak'k'e aceite t'a sjolom winhaj Salomón chi' yik tz'ochkan winh reyal t'a ko chonhab' tik. Tze pu'anpax nok' ch'a'ak tzex awaji: Niwanokab' yelk'och winhaj rey Salomón, xe chi.
Slajwi chi' tzex k'eul yet' winh t'a tik, haxo yochkan winh t'a yol in despacho tik reyal in k'exulok, yujto toxo ix wala' to a winh ol ochkan reyal t'a chonhab' Israel yet' t'a Judá, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Benaía chi' icha tik: --Ichokab'ta' mamin rey. Aokab' Jehová Dios sb'oankan icha chi'.
Icha wal ix aj yoch Jehová het'ok, ichokab'ta' ol aj yoch yet' winhaj Salomón chi', te niwanokab' ol aj yelk'och yopisio winh t'a yichanh iko', xchi winh.

Yuj chi', ix ak'jik'e winhaj Salomón chi' t'a yib'anh nok' smula winhaj rey David chi' yuj winhaj Sadoc chi', winhaj Natán schekab' Jehová Dios, winhaj Benaía chi' yet' heb' soldado stanhwan winh rey, haton heb' peleteo yet' heb' cereteo. Ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a sjaj ha' Gihón.

Ha winhaj sacerdote Sadoc chi' ix ik'ankot aceite t'a skajnub' Dios, ix yak'ank'e winh t'a sjolom winhaj Salomón chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yak'jioch winhaj Salomón chi' reyal yuj heb'. Ixlajwi chi' ix spu'an nok' ch'a'ak heb', ix awajk'e masanil anima: Niwanokab' yelk'och winhaj rey Salomón, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och tzak'an heb' anima chi' smasanil yuj winhaj Salomón chi', ix k'ek'och heb' t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén. Ix spu'an flauta heb', manhxa yalb'anil jantak tzalajk'olal, stak'wi lum witz yuj yel yaw heb'.

Hato wal slajwi swa winhaj Adonías yet' heb' ix yawtej, ix yab'an winh yoch jun aw chi'. Ix yab'anpax winhaj Joab yok' nok' ch'a'ak, ix yalan winh: --¿Tas yaj jun aw tz'och t'a chonhab' chi'? xchi winh.
Wanto wal slolon winhaj Joab chi', ix k'och winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Abiatar, ix yalan winhaj Adonías t'a winh: --Ochanhkoti, ach wach' a pensar, tekan wach' tas tzul ala', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Jonatán chi': --Tokwal wach'. Ha tiknaik toxo ix ak'jioch winhaj Salomón reyal yuj winhaj rey David sk'exulok.

Ha winh rey chi' ix chekanb'at winhaj sacerdote Sadoc, winhaj Natán schekab' Dios, winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, heb' cereteo yet' pax heb' peleteo yik sb'at heb' yet' winhaj Salomón. Ix yak'ank'e winhaj Salomón chi' heb' t'a yib'anh nok' smula winh rey chi'.

Ha winhaj sacerdote Sadoc chi' yet' winhaj Natán schekab' Dios chi', ix yak'k'e aceite heb' t'a sjolom winh t'a sjaj ha' Gihón, te tzalajk'olal yaj heb'. Ix meltzaj heb' t'a chonhab', yuj chi' ste awaj heb' anima chi' tzeyab'i.
Ha tiknaik toxo ix och k'ojan winhaj Salomón chi' t'a yol despacho.

Masanil heb' ay yopisio yet' winhaj rey David chi' ix b'at halan winhaj Salomón chi' wach'il. Ix yalan heb' to niwanokab' ol aj yelk'och winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi', niwanokab' pax ol aj smakb'en winh t'a yichanh yik winh smam chi'. Ha jun pax winhaj rey David chi' ix em nhojan t'a Dios t'a sat sch'at,

ix yalan winh: Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, yujto ix yak' t'a jun wuninal tik to ha' tz'em k'ojan t'a in despacho, tik wal tzato wila'', xchi winh, xchi winhaj Jonatán chi'.
Haxo jantak heb' awtab'il yuj winhaj Adonías chi', ix xiwk'e heb', junjunalxonhej ix aj spax heb'.

Ix xiwpaxk'e winhaj Adonías chi' t'a winhaj Salomón chi', yuj chi' ix b'at winh t'a yol skajnub' Jehová. Hata' ix b'at skol sb'a winh yalani. Ix och yub'yub' winh t'a sch'a'ak altar ayk'e t'a schikintak.

Elanhchamel ix b'at alchaj t'a winhaj Salomón chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, a wal tiknaik a winhaj Adonías ste xiw winh t'ayach. Ha t'a sch'a'ak altar ix b'at skol sb'a winh. Syalkot winh t'ayach tiknaik to tzak' a ti' to manh ol a milchamlaj winh, xchi heb'.
Ix tak'wi winh rey chi' icha tik: --Tato wach' syutej sb'a winh, max spitej sb'a winh t'ayin, manh ol chamlaj winh. Palta tato ay chukal ol sk'ulej winh jun, yowalil ol cham winh, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Salomón chi' to sb'at ik'jielta winhaj Adonías chi' b'aj ay altar chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winh, ix em nhojan winh. Ix yalan winhaj Salomón chi' t'a winh to smeltzaj winh t'a spat t'a junk'olal.
Toxo wal scham winhaj rey David chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winhaj Salomón yuninal icha tik:
Toxo ol in chamok icha tz'aj masanil heb' ketanimail. Tek'an wal tzutej a b'a, icha junok winak te tek'anxo spensar.

k'anab'ajej scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal, icha tas snib'ej, tas syal skachnab'il, scheknab'il yet' sk'ayb'ub'al tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés. Yuj chi' te wach'nhej ol aj yelk'och masanil tas ol a k'ulej yet' b'ajtak ol ach ek'ok.

Icha chi' ol aj yelk'och tas ix yalkan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Tato ol in sk'anab'ajejnhej heb' inhtilal, tato tojolnhej ol yutej sb'a heb' t'a wichanh yet' smasanil sk'o'ol yet' smasanil spensar, manh ol yak' palta heb' inhtilal yochnhejkan yajalil t'a Israel tik, xchi t'ayin.

Ojtakxo tas ix in yutej winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia, ix smilcham chawanh heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado ketisraelal winh: Haton winhaj Abner yuninal winhaj Ner yet' winhaj Amasa yuninal winhaj Jeter. Manhoklaj t'a skal owal ix miljicham heb' winh yuj winh, palta ichato t'a owal chi' ix cham heb' winh. Ichato ix b'onhchajb'at stzek'ul winh yet' xanhab' yuj schik'il heb' winh.
Yuj chi' nhikan tzutej a b'a, mokab' chamlaj winhaj Joab chi' t'a ichnhejta'.

Haxo pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Barzilai aj Galaad, tza xajanej heb' winh in k'ana', tzawtejnhej heb' winh wa'el het'ok. Ha heb' winh chi', ix kolwaj heb' winh wet'ok ayik ix in el t'a winh uk'tak aj Absalón chamnak.

Ha pax winhaj Simei ayek' t'a tik, winh yuninal winhaj Gera aj Bahurim t'a yinhtilal Benjamín, te chuk ix yal winh t'ayin ayik wan in b'at t'a Mahanaim, palta ix k'och winh in scha t'a sti' ha' Jordán. Ix wak' in ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to manh ol in milchamlaj winh.

Manh ak' niwank'olal winh. Anhej, a ach tik te nhikan ach. Scham a na'ani tas ol utej winh. Mokab' tonhejok ol cham winh ichnhej ta', palta to ol miljokcham winh, xchi winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.
Haxo yik ix cham winhaj rey David chi', ha t'a chonhab' skuch Schonhab' David, hata' ix mukchaj winh.
40 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a chonhab' Israel. Uke' ab'il t'a Hebrón, 33 ab'il t'a Jerusalén.
Haxo winhaj Salomón ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi'. Te tek'an ix aj winhaj Salomón yet' yopisio chi'.
Ha winhaj Adonías yune' ix Haguit, ix b'at winh yil ix Betsabé, ix snun winhaj Salomón. Ix sk'anb'an ix t'a winh icha tik: --¿T'a junk'olal am tzach jawi? xchi ix. --I', t'a junk'olal, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh: --Ay wal jun tas tzin nib'ej swal t'ayach, xchi winh t'a ix. --Ala', xchi ix.
--Ojtak to toxonton wik yaj jun reyal tik. Ix stanhwej masanil chonhab' Israel b'ak'inh tzin och reyal. Haxo tiknaik jun, haxo winh wuk'tak ix och reyal chi', yujto icha chi' ix aj sna'an Jehová.
Ha tiknaik ay wal jun tas tzin k'an t'ayach, komonok manh ol a tenek'i, xchi winh t'a ix. --Al tas tza nib'ej chi', xchi ix.
Ix yalan winh: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzal t'a winhaj rey Salomón to syak' ix Abisag aj Sunem winh wetb'eyumok. Ol sk'anab'ajej winh tas tzala', xchi winh t'a ix.
--Ichokab'ta', ol wal t'a winh rey tas tza nib'ej chi', xchi ix Betsabé chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at ix yal t'a winhaj rey Salomón chi' tas ix yal winhaj Adonías chi'. Ixnhej yil winh rey chi' yochk'och ix, ix k'e wa'an winh, ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh ix. Ixlajwi chi', ix emxi k'ojan winh t'a yol sdespacho, ix schekan winh ik'chajkot jun niwan xila b'aj tz'em k'ojan ix snun winh chi' t'a swach' k'ab'.

Ix yalan ix: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to ay jayb'elanh in lolonel swal t'ayach, mokab' a tenek'i, xchi ix. --Al masanil tas tza k'an chi' nunin, manh a na' to ol in tenek' t'ayach, xchi winh rey chi' t'a ix.
--Komonok ab' tzak' ix Abisag aj Sunem yetb'eyumok winh uk'tak aj Adonías, xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi winh t'a ix snun chi': ¿Tas yuj tzul a k'an ix Abisag yetb'eyumok winhaj Adonías chi'? Ichato tzul a k'ana' to swak' wopisio tik t'a winh, yujto b'ab'el winak winh, aypaxoch winhaj sacerdote Abiatar yet' winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia yet' winh, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ixlajwi yalan juntzanh chi' winhaj rey Salomón chi', ix yak'an sti' winh t'a Jehová: Yak'okab' in ya'elal Jehová tato max cham winhaj Adonías yuj tas sk'an chi'.

Ha Jehová ix in ak'anoch reyal sk'exulok winh in mam, yik wach' tz'aj yelk'och b'aj ix yak' sti' to ix yak' jun opisio tik t'ayin yet' t'a smasanil winhtilal. Yuj chi' swak' in ti' t'a yichanh to a tiknaik ol cham winhaj Adonías chi', xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun rato chi' ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada to b'at smilcham winhaj Adonías chi' winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh smilcham winhaj Adonías chi'.

Ix yalanpax winh rey chi' t'a winhaj sacerdote Abiatar: Ha tiknaik swal t'ayach to tzach b'at t'a a chonhab' Anatot. Smoj wal tzach chami, palta manh ol ach in milchamlaj yujto a ach ek'nak ach yilumalok te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a stiempoal winh in mam. Ha jun ach pax hab'nak sya'il t'a masanil b'aj yab'nak sya'il winh in mam chi', xchi winhaj Salomón chi'.
Icha chi' ix aj yelkan winhaj Abiatar chi' t'a sacerdoteal yuj winhaj Salomón chi', ix elkank'och tas alb'il yuj Jehová t'a Silo yuj heb' yinhtilal winhaj Elí.

Hanheja' winhaj Joab, ix yak'paxoch sb'a winh yet' winhaj Adonías chi', wach'chom maj yak'och sb'a winh yet' winhaj Absalón. Yuj chi', ayik ix k'och jun lolonel tik t'a winh, ix b'at sk'ub'anel sb'a winh t'a yol skajnub' Jehová yalani, ix och yub'yub' winh t'a sch'a'ak altar t'a schikintak.

Ix b'at alji t'a winhaj Salomón chi' chajtil to ha t'a altar t'a skajnub' Jehová, hata' ayek' winhaj Joab chi' skol sb'a. Ix yalan winhaj Salomón chi' t'a winhaj Benaía to sb'at winh smilcham winh ta'.

Ix b'at winh b'i'an, ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Joab chi': --Toxo ix yal winh rey to tzach elta, xchi winh t'a winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi': --Ma'ay. Ha t'a tik tzin chami, xchi winh. Ix b'at yalanxi winhaj Benaía chi' t'a winh rey tas ix yutej winhaj Joab chi' yalani.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Salomón chi': --Chamokab' winh ta', ujokab' icha snib'ej winh chi'. B'at a mukan sniwanil winh chi', yik wach' a schamel heb' malaj smul smilnakcham winh, manhxo'ok t'a yib'anh winh in mam yet' t'a wib'anh skani.

Aokab' Jehová tz'ak'ankanoch juntzanh chamel chi' smulok winh, yujto manhok winh in mam chekjinak winh ayik smilannak winhaj Abner winh, haton winh yuninal winhaj Ner yajalil heb' soldado Israel yet' winhaj Amasa yuninal winhaj Jeter yajalil heb' soldado Judá. Ha heb' winh chawanh chi' más te wach' heb' winh t'a yichanh winhaj Joab chi', tojol spensar heb' winh.

Ha schamel heb' winh chi' ochokab'kan smulok winhaj Joab chi' yet' heb' yinhtilal t'a junelnhej. Palta yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a kib'anh a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj rey David tik, ol onh ochnhejkan t'a sdespacho winh, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Benaía smilcham winhaj Joab chi'. Ayik toxo ix cham winh, ix b'at mukjikan sniwanil winh t'a spat t'a tzinan lu'um.
Haxo winh rey chi' ix ak'anoch winhaj Benaía chi' yajalilok heb' soldado sk'exulok winhaj Joab chi'. Ix ak'jipaxoch winhaj sacerdote Sadoc sk'exulok winhaj Abiatar.
Ixlajwi chi', ix awtaj winhaj Simei yuj winh rey chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --B'ok'e junok a pat t'a Jerusalén tik b'aj tzach kajnaji, junelnhej tzach kan t'a tik.
Tato tzach el jun, tzach k'axpajek' t'a ha' Cedrón, haxo a cham chi'. Ha a chamel chi', a ach tzik'kot t'a ib'anh, xchi winh rey chi' t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Simei chi': --Ichokab' ta' mamin rey, ol in k'anab'ajej tas tzal chi', xchi winh. Najtil ix ek' kajan winhaj Simei chi' t'a Jerusalén.

Palta haxo ix el yoxil ab'il, ix el chawanh heb' winh schekab' winh, haxo t'a Gat b'aj ayoch winhaj Aquis yuninal winhaj Maaca reyal ix k'ochkan heb' winh. Haxo yik ix alji t'a winh to ha t'a Gat ayek' heb' winh schekab' winh chi',
elanhchamel ix yak'och stz'um nok' sb'uru winh. Ix b'at winh say heb' winh schekab' t'a Gat chi'. Haxo yik ix ilchaj heb' winh yuj winh ix yik'an meltzaj heb' winh.
Haxo ix yab'an winhaj Salomón to a winhaj Simei ix xit'ek' winh t'a Gat, palta ayxoek' winh t'a Jerusalén chi'.

Yuj chi' ix schek winh rey chi' awtajkot winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh: --¿Tom maj wal t'ayach to tzak' a ti' t'a yichanh Jehová to max yal el t'a yol chonhab' tik? Ix cham wal walan t'ayach tato ay b'aj tzach b'at t'a junokxo lugar tzach chamxonhej. Ina ix a tak'wej a ti'ok to tza k'anab'ajej tas ix wal chi'.
¿Tas yuj maj a k'anab'ajej b'aj ix ak' a ti' chi' t'a yichanh Jehová?
Nakot tiknaik jantak chukal alnak t'a winh in mam. Ha tiknaik a Jehová ol ach ch'olb'itanok, ol kotkan t'a ib'anh yuj masanil tas a k'ulejnak chi'.
Palta yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a wib'anh a in tik. Ha onh yinhtilal onh winhaj rey David tik ol onh ochnhejkan t'a sdespacho t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Benaía yik b'at smilcham winhaj Simei chi' winh. Ix smilancham winhaj Simei chi' winh. Icha chi' ix aj swach' ochkan reyal chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ix yik'laj sb'a winhaj Salomón yet' ix yisil winh sreyal Egipto yik tz'och junk'olal t'a skal schonhab' heb'. Ha t'a schonhab'kan winhaj David ix ik'jib'at ix yuj winh yakb'an sb'ochaj spalacio winh yet' stemplo Jehová yet' pax muro t'a spatiktak Jerusalén.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ha t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh, hata' syak' silab' heb' anima wach'chom manh smojok, yujto manto b'olaj stemplo Jehová.

Te ay wal och Jehová t'a sk'o'ol winhaj Salomón, sk'anab'ajej wal sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová winh, haton alb'ilkan yuj winh smam winh. Wach'chom icha chi', palta hanheja' ix yak' juntzanh silab' winh yet' incienso t'a Jehová t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh chi'.
Ix xit'ek' winh yak' silab' t'a Gabaón yujto, niwan yelk'och jun lugar chi'. Jun mil nok' silab' ix yak' nhusjok tz'a winh t'a jun altar ay ta'.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal ayik ayek' winh t'a Gabaón chi', ix sch'oxan sb'a Jehová t'a winh t'a wayichal. Ix yalan t'a winh: k'an tas tza nib'ej t'ayin, ol wak' t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.

Ix tak'wi winh: Mamin, a xajanejnak wal winh a chekab' aj David, haton winh in mam, yujto ach sk'anab'ajejnhej winh, tojolnhej yutejnak sb'a winh t'ayach. Yuj chi' ix el t'a a k'o'ol to a in yuninal in winh tik tzin emkan k'ojan t'a sdespacho, icha ix aj yelk'och tiknaik.
Mamin Jehová in Diosal, wach'chom kelem hinto, mantalaj in jelanil yik swalan tas tz'aj heb' anima, palta ix el wal t'a a k'o'ol ix in ak'anoch reyal sk'exulok winh in mam chi'.
Haxo tiknaik ayinxo och yilumalok a chonhab' sik'b'ilel u'uj tik. Ha wal jun a chonhab' tik te niwan, maxtzak b'ischaj heb' anima.

Yuj chi' tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak' in jelanil yik wach' ol yal in kuchb'ani yet' snachajel wu'uj b'aj ay tas wach' yet' tas chuk. ¿Tas wal ol aj in ch'olb'itan jun a chonhab' te niwan tik, tato manh ol ak' in jelanil? xchi winh.
Ix scha wal sk'ol Jehová tas ix sk'an winh chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal icha tik: Yujto maj a k'ana' yik snajtilax a k 'inal, manhok pax a b'eyumal, ma schamel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach ix a k'ana', palta a a jelanil ix a k'ana' yik tza ch'olb'itan in chonhab' tik,
yuj chi' ol wak' tas tza k'an chi'. Ol wak' a jelanil chi'. Malaj junok mach ek'nakxo lajan spensar icha ach tik. Malaj pax junokxo mach ol pitzwokcha'anh ayik toxo ix ach ek'b'ati.
Manhoknhejlaj chi' ol wak' t'ayach, palta ol wak'pax a b'eyumal yet' sniwanil elk'ochi, wach'chom maj a k'ana'. Syalelk'ochi to malaj junokxo rey icha ach tik yakb'an pitzan ach.
Tato ol a k'anab'ajejnhej tas tzin nib'ej yet' in cheknab'il icha aj sk'anab'ajannak winh a mam, ol wak' najatb'ok a k 'inal, xchi Dios chi' t'a winh.

Haxo yik ix el swayanh winhaj rey Salomón chi', ix nachajel yuj winh to wan swayichan winh. Haxo yik ix jax winh t'a Jerusalén, ix b'at winh b'aj ayek' skaxail strato Jehová, hata' ix schek winh nhusjoktz'a silab' stz'a smasanil yet' silab' yik junk'olal yet' Dios. Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtan winh masanil heb' ayoch yopisio yet'ok yik swa heb' yet' winh.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix k'och chawanh heb' ix ajmul ix sb'o yaj jun yowal t'a yichanh winhaj rey Salomón chi'.
Ix yalan jun ix t'a winh: --Mamin rey, a in tik yet' jun ix tik junnhej patil kaji. Ayik ix k'och sk'ual, ix alji jun wune'.
Schab'jial wal chi', ix aljipax yik ix tik. Ha onnhej ko chawanhil t'a yol te' pat chi', malaj junokxo mach.
Haxo t'a jun ak'wal ix sk'anhatzancham yune' ix chi' ayik te chamnak el ix swayi.

Axom t'a chimilak'wal, ix k'e wa'an ix, ayik te chamnak in el in wayi, ix yik'ank'e wa'an yune' ix chamnakxo chi', ix ul stelb'ankanoch ix t'a in tz'ey, haxo wik pitzan chi' ix yik'b'at ix t'a stz'ey sk'exulok yik chi'.
Haxo yik ix sakb'i jun, ix wak'an yim wune' chi' walani, palta chamnakxo. Haxo yik ix te sakb'i, ix wilani to manh wikoklaj jun unin chi', xchi ix.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan yik junxo ix chi': --Ma'ay, a jun unin pitzan tik wiko', haxo jun chamnakxo chi' iko', xchi ix chi'. Ix yalanpax ix b'ab'el chi': --Ma'ay, a jun chamnakxo chi' iko', haxo jun pitzan tik wiko', xchi ix. Icha chi' ix aj stelan sb'a heb' ix t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh: Ha jun ix tik syal ix: Wik jun unin pitzan tik, haxo jun chamnakxo chi' iko', xchi ix. Hanheja' junxo ix chi', icha chi' syutej ix yalan t'a ix b'ab'el ix halan chi', xchi winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh: --Ik'ekkot junok k'e'en espada t'ayin, xchi winh. Ayik ix ja k'e'en espada chi',
ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --Chab' tzeyutej jun unin pitzan tik, tzeyak'an nanhalok yik junjun heb' ix, xchi winh.

Ha ix ay yik jun nene' unin pitzan chi', ix och wal pitz'naj kusk'olal t'a spixan ix, ix yalan ix t'a winh rey chi': --Mamin rey, elokab' t'a a k'ol max chab'ajlaj snanhal jun unin tik. Ak'jokab' t'a ix tik, xchi ix. Ix yalan junxo ix chi': --Max kanlaj wet'ok, max kanpaxlaj yet' ix tik. Chab'ajokab' snanhal, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix yalan winh rey chi': --Manh he milcham jun unin chi', ak'ek t'a ix malaj snib'ej smiljicham chi', yujto wal yel a ix ay yiko', xchi winh.

Masanil heb' aj Israel chi', ix yab' heb' tas ix aj sb'o'an yaj jun owal chi' winh rey chi'. Te niwan ix aj yelk'och winh t'a sat heb', yujto ix nachajel yuj heb' to ix ak'ji sjelanil winh yuj Dios yik sb'o'an yaj owal winh.
Ix och winhaj Salomón reyal t'a smasanil heb' yetisraelal.

Ha heb' winh ayoch yet' winh t'a yopisio, haton heb' winh tik: Ha winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Sadoc ayoch sacerdoteal. Ha winhaj Elihoref yet' winhaj Ahías, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sisa, a heb' winh stz'ib'an yab'ixal tas sk'ulej winh rey chi'. Ha winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Ahilud, a winh tz'ib'um yaj t'a winh rey chi'. Ha winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, a winh ayoch yajalilok heb' soldado. Ha winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Abiatar, a heb' winh sacerdote yaji. Ha winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Natán, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' winh gobernador. Ha winhaj Zabud yuninal pax winhaj Natán chi', sacerdote yaj winh, ak'um pax razón yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'. Ha winhaj Ahisar tz'ilan tas ay t'a spalacio winh rey chi'. Haxo winhaj Adoniram yuninal winhaj Abda, a winh tz'ilan heb' munlajwum yowalil smunlaji.

Ha winhaj Salomón chi', ay lajchawanh heb' winh gobernador t'a masanil yol smakb'en Israel tz'ak'an serwil winh. Ha yopisio heb' winh chi', junjun heb' winh t'a junjun ujal t'a yol ab'il, syik'kot heb' winh tastak syab'lej winh rey chi' yet' heb' ayek' yet' winh t'a spalacio.
Ha lajchawanh heb' winh gobernador chi', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Ben-hur, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín.
Winhaj Ben-decar, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a juntzanh chonhab' tik: Macaz, Saalbim, Bet-semes, Elón yet' Bet-hanán.
Ha winhaj Ben-hesed, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a Arubot, t'a Soco yet' t'a masanil yol yik Hefer.
Ha winhaj Ben-abinadab, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a masanil yol smakb'en Dor, a ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix Tafat yisil winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ha winhaj Baana yuninal winhaj Ahilud, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a Taanac, Meguido yet' t'a masanil yol yik Bet-seán. Ha jun chonhab' chi' junnhej yaj yet' Saretán, t'a yalanhemta Jezreel, sb'atnhej t'a Bet-seán masanto sk'och t'a Abel-mehola yet' t'a sk'axepalb'at Jocmeam.

Ha winhaj Ben-geber, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad yet' t'a masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Galaad chi', haton juntzanh schonhab' heb' yinhtilalkan Jair yuninal Manasés yet' pax t'a yol smakb'en Argob t'a yol yik Basán. Hata' ay 60 niwak chonhab' ayoch smuroal, ayoch k'e'en bronce tzek' k'atan syamnub'alok spuertail.
Ha winhaj Ahinadab yuninal winhaj Iddo, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a Mahanaim.
Ha winhaj Ahimaas, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a yol yik Neftalí. Haton jun winh chi' ix yik'laj sb'a yet' ix Basemat yisil winhaj Salomón.
Ha winhaj Baana yuninal winhaj Husai, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a yol yik Aser yet' t'a Alot.
Ha winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Parúa, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a yol yik Isacar.
Ha winhaj Simei yuninal winhaj Ela, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a yol yik Benjamín.

Ha winhaj Geber yuninal winhaj Uri, a winh tz'ik'ankot tastak tz'ab'laj chi' t'a yol yik Galaad, haton b'aj ek'nak schonhab' winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo yet' winhaj Og sreyal Basán. Anhej winhaj Geber chi' yajal yaj t'a jun makan lum lum chi'.
Ha heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Israel maxtzak b'ischaji jantak sb'isul heb', lajan heb' icha yarenail sti' ha' mar. Manh jantakok tas swaji yet' tas tz'uk'ji, tzalajk'olalnhej yajek' heb'.

Ha winhaj Salomón rey t'a yib'anh masanil juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Skotnhej t'a ha' Éufrates masanto sja t'a schonhab' heb' filisteo yet' t'a smojonal yik Egipto. Ha masanil juntzanh chonhab' chi', junjun ab'il syak'an k'e'en tumin heb' yik stupan heb' b'aj aykan t'a yalanh scheknab'il winhaj Salomón chi' yakb'an pitzan winh.
Ha masanil tastak syab'lej winhaj Salomón chi' t'a junjun k'u yet' heb' kajan yet' winh, haton tik: 70 quintal ixim harina te chok' yaji, 140 quintal pax ixim we'ech yaji,
lajunhwanh nok' mam wakax te b'ak'ech, 20 pax nok' libre yaj t'a yol potrero yet' 100 nok' kalnel. Ch'ok pax yaj nok' k'ultakil chej, nok' ch'ukul yet' nok' much te b'ak'ech.

Ix yak' wal yajalil winhaj Salomón chi' t'a yib'anh lum lum schakot t'a stitak ha' Éufrates, skotnhej t'a Tifsa masanto tz'emk'och t'a Gaza. Yajal yaj winh t'a yib'anh masanil heb' winh sreyal juntzanh nación chi'. Ay junk'olal t'a skal winh yet' juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a spatiktak chi'.
Ayik pitzanto winhaj Salomón chi', masanil anima t'a yol yik Judá yet' Israel skotnhej t'a Dan masanto t'a Beerseba, junk'olal yaj heb'. Junjun heb' ay te' yawb'ente' t'a spatiktak spat.
Ha winhaj Salomón chi', ay pax juntzanh pat b'aj ayoch 40 mil nok' chej stok'an carruaje yik owal yuj winh. Ay pax 12 mil heb' soldado sk'e t'a yib'anh nok' chej chi'.
Masanil heb' winh tz'ik'ankot tastak syab'lej winhaj rey Salomón yet' masanil heb' winh swa yet' winh, scham wal yilan heb' winh tato tz'akan syab' t'a jun uj chi'.
Ha heb' winh ayoch t'a yib'anh yik'ankot juntzanh chi', syik'paxkot ixim cebada yet' anh yanh nok' chej chi' heb' winh yet' yik juntzanhxo nok' chej tok'um ikatz yalnhej b'aj ay.
Manhxo jantakok sjelanil winhaj Salomón chi' ix ak'ji yuj Dios. Manhxo alchajb'enok jantak sjelanil winh chi'.
Ha sjelanil winh chi', te ek'to t'a yichanh yik heb' aj Egipto yet' t'a yichanh yik heb' ay b'aj sjawi k'u.

Te jelan winh t'a yib'anh juntzanh heb' winh winak b'inajnak yuj sjelanil, haton winhaj Etán yinhtilal winhaj Zera, winhaj Hemán, winhaj Calcol yet' winhaj Darda, haton heb' winh yuninal winhaj Mahol. Ha sb'inajnakil sjelanil winh chi', ix k'och spekal t'a masanil juntzanh chonhab' t'a spatik yichanh Israel.
Ha winhaj Salomón chi', oxe' mil k'ayb'ub'al yik jelanil ix yalkan winh, ix sb'oanpax mil cinco b'it winh.

Ix lolon winh t'a yib'anh te te' yet' t'a yib'anh tas tz'awchaji. Ix schael yich winh slolon t'a te' k'ute' ay t'a Líbano masanto t'a yib'anh te' hisopo sk'ib'k'e t'a spatiktak te' pat. Ix lolonpax winh t'a yib'anh juntzanh nok' chanhe' yok, nok' much, nok' tzek' t'a sat lu'um yet' t'a yib'anh nok' chay ay t'a yoltak ha ha'.
Ha heb' winh sreyal masanil juntzanh nación ix ab'an jantak sjelanil winh, ix schekkot heb' anima heb' winh yik tzul yab'an sjelanil winh heb'.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro to a winhaj Salomón ix och reyal sk'exulok winh smam, ix yak'ankot heb' schekab' winh yik tzul lolon heb' yet' winh, yujto te wach'taxon yak'an winh yet' winhaj David.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxib'at winhaj Salomón t'a winhaj Hiram chi' icha tik:

Ha ach tik ojtak to maj yal-laj sb'oankank'e junok stemplo Jehová ko Diosal winh in mam yujto niwan tiempoal ix yak' owal winh, masanto a Jehová ix ak'anoch heb' ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winh.
Ha tiknaik jun, toxo ix yak' junk'olal Jehová t'ayonh israel onh tik, manhxalaj heb' ajk'ol t'ayonh, manhxalaj chukal b'aj tzonh xiwi.

Yuj chi', toxo ix in na' to ol in b'ok'e junok stemplo Jehová ko Diosal, icha ajnak yalan t'a winh in mam chi', ayik yalannak icha tik: Ha junok uninal ol ochkan t'a yol sdespacho a k'exulok, ha' ol b'oank'e junok in templo, xchi Jehová t'a winh in mam chi'.

Yuj chi', tzin k'an t'ayach to ol a chek ik'jokel ste'al, haton te' k'ute' t'a Líbano. Ol wak'b'at heb' winh in chekab' yik skolwaj heb' winh yet' heb' winh a chekab' chi'. Ol in tup sk'u heb' winh icha jantak tza k'ana', yujto ojtak to malaj junok onh syal kik'anel te' icha ex aj Sidón ex chi', xchib'at winh.

Ix te tzalaj winhaj Hiram chi' ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix yalb'at winhaj Salomón chi'. Ix yalan winh: Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto ix yak' jun yuninal winhaj David te nhikan ix ochkan sk'exulok skuchb'an jun niwan chonhab' chi', xchi winh.
Elanhchamel ix yalxikot winh t'a winhaj Salomón chi': Toxo ix wab' tas ix alkoti, tik tzin chek ik'jokel te' k'ute' yet' te' taj icha ix al chi', ol wak'b'at te' t'ayach.

Ol yik'emta te' heb' winh in chekab' t'a Líbano, ol emk'och te' t'a sti' ha' mar. Yaman ol aj te' yik ol laj b'at te' t'a yib'anh ha', icha chi' ol aj sk'och te' b'aj ix ala'. Hata' ol he cha te', ol eyik'anb'at te' b'i'an. Ha hachxo jun, ol ak'kot tas ol in wa yet' heb' anima t'a in palacio tik stojolok te', xchikot winh.
Ichaton chi' ix aj yak'an te' k'ute' winhaj Hiram yet' te' taj ix och yopisio yuj winhaj Salomón chi'.
Haxo winhaj Salomón chi' ix ak'an jantak tas tz'och yuj winhaj Hiram chi' t'a junjun ab'il: 75 mil quintal ixim trigo yet' 115 mil galón aceite yik sat te' olivo.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'ji sjelanil spensar winhaj Salomón chi' yuj Jehová, icha ix aj yalani. Ix sb'o'an strato winh yet' winhaj Hiram chi' yik ay junk'olal t'a skal heb' winh schawanhil.

Ix schek winhaj Salomón chi' to ha t'a masanil yol yik Israel smolchaj heb' winh winak to yowalil sb'at t'a munlajel t'a Líbano. Ha sb'isul heb' winh chi', 30 mil heb' winh t'a smasanil. 10 mil heb' winh schekjib'at t'a junjun uj. Jun ujal xit'ek' heb' winh munlajel t'a Líbano chi', chab' ujal ayek' heb' winh t'a spat. Ha winhaj Adoniram ayoch yajalilok heb' winh 30 mil chi'.
Ay pax 70 mil heb' winh kuchum ikatz. Ay pax 80 mil heb' winh tzeyum k'e'en t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Israel chi'.
Ch'ok pax yaj oxe' mil 300 heb' winh ayoch t'a caporalil yilan munlajel chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Salomón chi' to stzeyji k'e'en niwak k'e'en, wach' tz'aj k'e'en stzeyji yik wach' a k'e'en tz'emkan yichok stemplo Jehová chi'.

Ha heb' winh smunlajwum winhaj Salomón yet' heb' winh yik winhaj Hiram chi' yet' pax heb' winh kajan t'a Gebal, ix sjoch te te' heb' winh, ix stzeyanpax k'e'en k'e'en heb' winh yik tz'och t'a templo chi'.
Ayik 480 ab'ilxo yelta heb' israel t'a Egipto, chanhexo ab'il yoch winhaj Salomón reyal, yik schab'ilxo ujal yoch jun ab'il chi', haton t'a uj skuch Zif, ix el yich sb'ochaj stemplo Jehová.
Ha jun templo chi', a winhaj Salomón ix halani to sb'o'i yik tz'ik'jicha'anh Jehová. 27 metro ix aj sk'atul, b'alunhe' metro ix aj yol schikin, 13 metro yet' nanhalxo ix ajk'e scha'anhil.
Haxo yolxoelul sti', ay junxo makan yo'ol, b'alunhe' metro sat, lajan icha yol schikin templo chi', haxo jantak ayeluli, nanhal yo'il metro.
Ha swentenail templo chi', lewnik ix ajkan sat t'a yo'ol, haxo t'a spatik lot'an.
Ix b'ochajpaxoch lotzan jun pat, ix oymaj t'a skostiltak templo chi' yet' t'a junxo yol schikin. Makkiltak ix aj yo'ol, hata' sik'chaj tastak tz'ak'ji t'a Jehová.

Oxe' piso ix ajk'ei: Ha b'ab'el piso, chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro ix aj slewanil sat. Haxo schab'il piso, chab' metro yet' 70 centímetro ix aj sat. Haxo yoxil piso, oxe' metro yet' 15 centímetro ix aj sat. Jab'jab'il ix utz' spimal skajonal sk'atul templo chi' t'a spatikeli, yujto b'akhkiltak ix ajkani yik wach' max olji spak'ul templo chi' b'aj tz'och spatzab'il jun pat chi'.

Ha jantak k'e'en k'e'en ix och t'a templo chi', tzeyb'il k'e'en smasanil. Wach'xo yaj k'e'en ayik ix jawi k'e'en, yuj chi' manhxalaj b'aj ix ab'chaj sk'anh junok k'e'en mak'umpoj k'e'en, ma junok k'e'en tzeylab' k'e'en, ma yalnhej tas k'enal.
Ha spuertail jun pat chi', ha t'a stojolal ko k'exanh yik tzonh och t'a yol templo chi' ix kani. Haxo sk'o'ochal sk'e t'a juntzanhxo piso chi' tzek' oyoyok.
Ayik ix b'oel skajonal templo chi', ix och spatzab'il, haxo te' niwak chemte' nab'a k'ute' ix em t'a yib'anh te'.
Ayik ix b'ochaj jun pat t'a spatiktak templo chi', chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro ix ajk'e schanhil junjun piso. Ix och spatzab'il, ix k'och tenan te' t'a templo chi', nab'a k'ute' te' patzab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Salomón chi' icha tik:

Yuj jun templo wan a b'oan tik, swal t'ayach, tato tzach ochnhej tzak'an t'a spatik in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il, tza k'anab'ajan smasanil, ol elk'och masanil tas walnak t'a winhaj David winh a mam.
Ol in ajnhejek' t'a he kal a ex israel ex tik, manh ol ex waktejkani, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ayik ix lajwi sb'oel templo ix schek b'ojok winhaj Salomón chi',

te wach' ix ajoch te' chemte' t'a sattak schanhil pak'anh t'a yo'ol, nab'a k'ute' te' chemte' chi'. Ix b'atnhej te' t'a yich masanto ix k'ek'och te' t'a yalanh te' patzab'. Ix empax te' chemte' nab'a taj t'a yo'ol.

Ha t'a yol templo chi' t'a yichochi, ix makchaj jun cuarto, b'alunhe' metro ix aj yo'ol t'a schanhil pak'anh. Ha te' chemte' ix och chi' t'ay, nab'a k'ute' te'. Ix b'atnhej te' t'a yich masanto ix k'ek'och te' t'a yalanh te' patzab'. Ha jun cuarto chi', haton jun lugar Yiknhej Jehová Yaji.
Haxo junxo makan yol templo t'a yichanhelta jun cuarto chi', 18 metro ix ajkan spak'ultak.
Ha te' chemte' ix och t'a yol templo chi', nab'a a te' k'ute'. Yoch'b'iloch yechel sat te te' yet' te' xumak yelwanub'ok sattak te'. Malaj junok k'e'en k'e'en chekel t'a yo'ol chi'.
Te wach' ix aj sb'o jun lugar Yiknhej Jehová Yaji, yujto hata' ix och te' skaxail strato Jehová chi'.

Ha spak'ultak yo'ol chi' schanhil, b'alunhe' metro ix aj junjun, b'alunhe' metro pax ix ajk'e scha'anhil. Ix ak'chajoch k'e'en oro jay yaj stenchaj t'a sattak spak'ul chi' t'a yo'ol. Ix b'ojipax jun altar nab'a k'ute', ix ochpax k'e'en oro chi' t'ay.
Ix ochpax k'e'en oro chi' t'a te' chemte' ayoch t'a yol templo chi' smasanil. Haxo k'e'en cadena ix och t'a spuertail jun lugar Yiknhej Jehová Yaji, nab'a oro k'e'en.
Syalelk'ochi, masanil yol templo chi', nab'a oro ix aji. Nab'a oro pax ix aj jun altar ay t'a spatikelta sti' jun lugar Yiknhej Dios Yaj chi'.
Ix yak'pax b'ojok chab' yechel querubín winh t'a te' olivo, ix ochkan t'a jun lugar Yiknhej Jehová Yaji. Nanhal yo'il metro ix ajk'e scha'anhil junjun.
Chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro ix ajel jenhan junjun sk'axil, yuj chi' nanhal yo'il metro ix ajel jenhan sk'axil junjun heb' querubín chi' schab'il.
Lajannhej yajel jenhan sk'axil heb' chi' schawanhil, lajan pax yilji heb'.
Nanhal yo'il metro ix ajk'e scha'anhil ste'el junjun heb'.

Ix ak'jioch yechel heb' querubín chi' t'a yol jun lugar Yiknhej Jehová Yaji. Jenhanel sk'axil junjun heb', yuj chi' junjun snhi' sk'axil heb' sk'och tenan t'a junjun spak'ul yo'ol chi'. Haxo junjunxo sk'axil heb' schalaj sb'a t'a snanhal yol jun lugar chi'.
Ix ak'chajoch k'e'en oro jay yaj stenchaj t'a spatiktak heb' querubín chi'.
T'a masanil sattak spak'ul yol chab' cuarto ay t'a yol templo chi', ix ak'jioch yechel querubín, yechel te' palma yet' yechel xuma'ak yelwanub'ok.
Ix ak'jipaxem k'e'en oro jay yaj t'a yib'anh te' chemte' ayem t'a yol cuarto chi' schab'il.

Ha te' spuertail jun lugar Yiknhej Jehová Yaj chi', chab' yaj te'. B'ob'il te' t'a te' olivo, haxo yelwanub' te' yoch'b'ilochi, haton yechel querubín, te' palma yet' xuma'ak. Ha te' puerta chi' yet' yelwanub', ix ak'jioch k'e'en oro t'a te' yet' t'a te' smarcoal te' linhjab'k'ei yet' t'a chab' te' utz'el tz'aj scha'an sb'a t'a yib'anh te' puerta chi'.

Ix ak'jipaxoch te' smarcoal sti' templo chi', hanheja' ha t'a te' olivo b'ob'il te', tojol ix ajek' k'atan te'. Haxo te' spuertail ix och chi', ha t'a te' taj ix b'oji te', chab' jenhan ix aj te'. Junjun jenhan te', hanhejtona' linhanpax tz'aj spakchaj snanhal te'.
Ix yoch'jipaxoch yelwanub' te': Haton yechel querubín, yechel te' palma yet' yechel xuma'ak. Ix ak'jipaxoch k'e'en oro t'a te'.
Ix b'ochajpaxoch smuroal templo chi', ix ek' hoyan t'a spatiktak. Ox tzol k'e'en k'e'en tzeyb'il slatz'jik'ei, haxo t'a yib'anh k'e'en tzek' te' k'ute', ichanhej chi' ix aj sk'e'i.
Ix el yich yak'jiem yich stemplo Jehová t'a uj Zif ayik schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Salomón reyal.
Haxo t'a swajxakil uj skuchan Bul, ayik yuxluchil ab'il yoch winh reyal, ix b'oel jun templo chi' smasanil, icha wal yaj yechel b'ob'ilkani. Uke' ab'il ix yak' sb'o'i.
Ix sb'opaxk'e spalacio winhaj Salomón chi', 13 ab'il ix yak' winh sb'o'ani.

Ix sb'oanpaxk'e jun niwan pat winh, te lewan ix aj yo'ol. Ix yak'an skuch winh Spatil Te Te' yik Líbano. 45 metro ix aj sk'atul, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo ix aj yol schikin, 13 metro yet' nanhalxo ix ajk'e scha'anhil. Chanh tzol ix ajoch yoyal, nab'a k'ute'. Haxo t'a sjolomtak te' oy chi', ix ek' te' patzab' nab'a k'ute'.
Ha juntzanh te' patzab' chi' 45 te', ox tzol ix ajek' te', 15 te' t'a junjun tzol. Haxo t'a yib'anh te' ix b'at te' nab'a k'ute' ix och yib'anhok jun pat chi'.
Ox tzol ix ajk'e swentenail t'a junjun spak'ul. K'elk'umb'a ix aj juntzanh wentena chi'.
Oxox sti' aykan t'a junjun yol schikin. Hanheja' k'elk'umb'a ix aj junjun. Ha smarcoal spuertail yet' swentenail, tojol ix ajek' k'atan t'a yib'anh.
Ix b'opax junxo niwan pat, 22 metro yet' nanhalxo ix aj sk'atul, 13 metro yet' nanhalxo ix aj yol schikin. Ix yak'an skuch winh Yoyal Pat. Haxo t'a stentail ayoch yoyal yet' yib'anh.
Ix sb'oanpax junxo pat winh b'aj sch'olb'itaj heb' anima. Hanheja' te' k'ute' ix och t'a sattak t'a yo'ol chi'. Ix b'atnhej t'a yich masanto ix k'ek'och t'a yalanh te' patzab'.

Haxo pax b'aj kajan winhaj Salomón chi' t'a spalacio, ha t'a spatik jun pat b'aj sch'olb'itaj heb' anima chi' ay. Lajannhej ix aj sb'o icha ix aj sb'o juntzanh pat chi'. Ix yak'anpax b'ojok junxo pat yik ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix yisil winh sreyal Egipto. Lajan ix aj sb'o icha ix aj yik winh.

Ha masanil juntzanh pat chi', icha ix aj skot t'a yich, icha chi' ix aj sk'ek'och t'a schon. Icha chi' ix ajpax yamak'il. Ha k'e'en k'e'en ix laj och t'ay te wach' yaj k'e'en stzeychaji icha yaj yechel. Ha k'e'en ix cheklajkan t'a spatik yet' t'a yo'ol, polb'il k'e'en t'a k'e'en polum k'e'en.
Hanheja' k'e'en ix kan t'a yich, a k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yaj sb'o'i, a k'e'en ix kan t'ay, te niwak k'e'en. Ay k'e'en nanhal yo'il metro sk'atul, ay pax k'e'en oxe' metro yet' 60 centímetro sk'atul.
Ha t'a yib'anh k'e'en yich chi', ix och k'e'en k'e'en tzeyb'il icha wal yaj yechel. Ix ochpax te' k'ute' jochb'il yet' k'e'en k'e'en.

Ha t'a spatiktak jun niwan amak' chi', ix och ox tzol k'e'en k'e'en. Haxo t'a yib'anh k'e'en ix ochpax jun tzol te' patzab' nab'a k'ute'. Ichanhej chi' ix aj sk'e t'a cha'anh, icha ix aj sb'o jun ix och t'a spatiktak templo yet' pax jun ix b'o t'a yolelul sti' templo chi'.
Ay jun winh aj Tiro skuch Hiram ix yawtejkot winhaj rey Salomón chi'.

Ha jun winh chi', yune' winh jun ix chamnak yetb'eyum t'a yinhtilal Neftalí, aj Tiro winh smam winh, te jelan winh sb'o'an k'e'en bronce. Hanhejtona' te jelan pax spensar winh, yojtak winh sb'o'an yalnhej tas munlajelal t'a k'e'en bronce chi'. Yuj chi' ix awtajkot winh yik smunlaj winh t'a winhaj rey Salomón sb'o'an juntzanh tas nab'a bronce.
Ix sb'o chab' niwak oy winh, nab'a bronce ix aji, wajxake' metro ste'el junjun, nanhal swakil metro ix aj b'alan spatik junjun.
Ix sb'oanpax chab' sjolom chab' oy chi' winh. Ha ste'el juntzanh sjolom chi', chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro ix aji.
Ha t'a spatiktak chab' sjolom chi' ix ak'jioch k'e'en cadena bronce, icha k'e'en malla yaj k'e'en sb'o'i. Uke' ayoch t'a junjun sjolom chi'.
Ix sb'opax cha tzol icha yechel sat te' granado winh. Ix och t'a juntzanh cadena chi' yik tz'och t'a spatik junjun sjolom oy chi'. Lajannhej ix aj schab'il.
Ha juntzanh jolom oy chi', ay am chab'ok metro ayk'ei, lajan yilji icha anh chochol.

Ha chab' sjolom juntzanh oy chi' k'olan k'olan yaji. Haxo t'a yib'anh, hata' ayk'e junxo icha anh chochol chi'. Ha b'aj tz'emul k'e'en cadena t'a spatiktak jun k'olan k'olan chi', hata' ayoch 200 yechel sat te' granado, cha tzol yajochi.

Ix yak'och chab' oy winhaj Hiram chi' t'a sat templo chi'. Ayik ix yak'anem winh t'a yet'tal, ay jun ix kan t'a ko k'exanh ayik tzonh och t'a yol templo chi', Jaquín ix yak' winh sb'iej. Haxo junxo oy chi' ix kan t'a ko wach', Boaz ix yak' winh sb'iej.
Ha sjolom juntzanh oy chi', lajan yilji icha xumakil anh chochol. Icha chi' ix aj juntzanh oy chi' sb'o'an winhaj Hiram chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'o'an jun niwan pila nab'a bronce winhaj Hiram chi', yik b'aj smolchaj ha ha'. Suyansuyan ix aji, nanhal yo'il metro ix aj slewanil sat. Haxo ix ajk'e scha'anhil ste'el, chab' metro yet' 25 centímetro ix aji, haxo ix aj setan smasanil, 13 metro yet' nanhalxo.
Ha t'a yalanh sti' jun pila chi', ayoch chab' tzol yechel sattak te te' icha yilji te' tzima. Lajunhe' ix och t'a junjun 45 centímetro, junnhej ix aj sb'o yet' jun pila chi'.

Ha jun pila chi' b'akhanem t'a yib' snanhal juntzanh yechel nok' mam wakax nab'a bronce. Ha juntzanh yechel nok' chi', oxe' k'elanb'at t'a stojolal sur, oxe' k'elanb'at t'a stojolal norte, oxe' k'elanb'at t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, oxe' pax k'elanb'at t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Ha yok juntzanh yechel wakax chi' aykanoch t'a yalanh jun pila chi'.
Ha jun pila chi' nab'a bronce ix aji, chanhek'ab'il spimal. Niwan yajel pechan sti' icha yilji xumakil anh chochol. Ha t'a yol jun pila chi', tz'em 44 mil litro ha ha'.
Ix sb'oanpax lajunhe' carreta winh, nab'a bronce ix aj junjun. Jun metro yet' 80 centímetro ix aj spak'ul schanhil, jun metro yet' 35 centímetro ix ajk'e ste'el.
Ha juntzanh carreta chi', icha tik yaji: Ay chanhe' smarcoal, makan yoltak sat smarcoal chi'.
Ha t'a sat juntzanh chi' ayoch yechel nok' choj, nok' toro yet' yechel querubín. Ha t'a yib'anh yet' t'a yalanh juntzanh yechel chi', hata' ayoch yelwanub' smarcoal chi'.

Junjun carreta chi' ay chanhe' syantail nab'a bronce, chab' k'e'en k'e'en k'atanek' t'a yalanh syaman syantail chi'. Ha t'a schanhil schikintak juntzanh carreta chi' t'a yib'anh, ay syamnub'al nab'a bronce, a syaman jun yune' pila ayem t'a yol jun carreta chi'. Ha juntzanh syamnub' chi' ayoch yelwanub'.

Haxo t'a yol jun carreta chi', ayem jun icha niwan tubo, 45 centímetro scha'anhil ayk'eta t'a yib'anh sti' juntzanh carreta chi'. Aypaxoch yelwanub' spatiktak jun niwan tubo chi', haxo schanh pak'anhil jun carreta chi', manh setansetanoklaj.
Ha chanhe' syantail chi' ayoch t'a schikintak schanhil. Haxo pax juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en syaman syantail chi', yaman yaj k'e'en yet' smarcoal chi'. Ha syantail chi', 70 centímetro yaj setan.
Lajan yaj sb'o juntzanh syantail chi' icha yik carruaje yik owal. Ha junjun syantail chi' yaman yaj yet' k'e'en k'e'en ayoch b'aj ay yolanil, nab'a bronce, junnhej yaj setan.
Ha chanhe' syamnub'al t'a schikintak carreta chi', junnhej yaj yet' smarcoal junjun carreta.
Ha t'a yib'anh carreta chi', ay junxo setanoch t'a spatik sti', 23 centímetro yajk'e scha'anhil. Ha jantak tas ayoch t'a junjun carreta chi', junnhej yaj sb'o smasanil.
Ha t'a spak'ultak yoltak smarcoal chi', ix yak'och yechel querubín winhaj Hiram chi' t'ay, nok' choj yet' te' palma. Ix ochnhej yelwanub' chi' t'a spatiktak smasanil.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'o lajunhe' carreta chi', lajannhej ix aj smasanil, lajannhej yechel, lajannhej pax yilji.

Ix sb'oanpax lajunhe' yet'tal ha' yik juntzanh carreta chi' winh, nab'a bronce ix aji. Lajannhej yechel smasanil. Jun metro yet' 80 centímetro yo'ol junjun, 800 litro am ha' tz'em t'a yo'ol. Junjun ay k'e t'a yib'anh scarretail.

Oye' juntzanh carreta chi' ix kan t'a stojolal ko wach' t'a templo, oye' pax ix kan t'a stojolal ko k'exanh. Haxo jun niwan pila, ha t'a ko k'exanh koch t'a templo chi' ix kani, t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sb'oanpax juntzanh chen, k'e'en pala yet' niwak uk'ab' winhaj Hiram chi'. Icha wal chi' ix aj slajwi sb'o smasanil juntzanh ix schek winhaj rey Salomón b'ojok yikok stemplo Jehová.
Haton masanil juntzanh tik ix chekji sb'o winhaj Hiram: Chab' niwak oy, chab' sjolom oy chi', juntzanh k'e'en cadena icha k'e'en malla nab'a bronce ayoch t'a spatiktak jolom oy chi',
yet' pax 400 yechel sat te' granado ayoch t'a juntzanh cadena chi'. Cha tzol yajoch t'a spatiktak chab' jolom oy chi'.
Lajunhe' carreta kuchjinak lajunhe' yet'tal ha',
jun niwan pila, lajchawe' yechel mam wakax kuchjinak,

juntzanh k'e'en chen, juntzanh k'e'en pala yet' juntzanh k'e'en niwak uk'ab'. Masanil juntzanh yamk'ab' tik ix sb'o winhaj Hiram t'a winhaj rey Salomón yikok stemplo Jehová, nab'a bronce to kopopi yilji.
Ix schek winh rey chi' b'ojok t'a moldeal t'a yak'likal sti' ha' Jordán t'a lum b'ak'ech lu'um, t'a skal snanhal Sucot yet' Saretán.
Te tzijtum yamk'ab' nab'a bronce, yuj chi' majxo yechtej winhaj rey Salomón chi' jantak yalil k'e'en bronce chi' ix k'anchaji.
Ix schekanpax winh rey chi' b'ojok masanil juntzanhxo yamk'ab' nab'a oro t'a yol stemplo Jehová: Jun altar, jun mexa b'aj tz'ak'jiem ixim pan t'a yichanh Jehová,

juntzanh b'akhnub' candil yet' yelwanub' icha yechel xuma'ak, haton ayoch t'a yichanh lugar Yiknhej Jehová Yaji. Ay oye' t'a stojolal ko wach', ay oyexo t'a stojolal ko k'exanh, juntzanh candil, juntzanh yamlab',

juntzanh kopa, juntzanh k'e'en ik'lab'el stanhil b'aj ayoch sk'ak'al candil, juntzanh niwak uk'ab', juntzanh niwak cuchara yet' juntzanh chaynub' yik incienso. Masanil juntzanh chi' nab'a oronhej. Haxo k'e'en wisagre ayoch t'a spuertail jun lugar Yiknhej Jehová Yaji, haton t'a yol templo yet' pax yik spuertail templo chi', nab'a oronhej.

Ayik ix b'oel masanil tas ix schek winhaj Salomón b'ojok yik stemplo Jehová, ix schekan winh ik'jokb'at masanil k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' yak'nakkan winhaj David smam winh t'a Jehová. Ix schekan winh sik'chajkan t'a yol juntzanh pat ay t'a spatiktak templo b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ochkan yikok Jehová.

Ha te' skaxail strato Jehová, ayek' te' t'a schonhab' winhaj David skuchan Sion. Haxo winhaj Salomón ix na'ani to syik'b'at te' winh t'a yol templo yakb'an molanek' masanil heb' anima t'a Jerusalén yuj sna'ankot k'inh chinama heb' t'a yukil uj skuchan Etanim. Yuj chi' ix smolb'an masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel winh, heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun yinhtilal heb' yet' heb' sat yaj t'a junjun makan heb'.
Haxo heb' sacerdote yet' juntzanhxo heb' levita ix ik'anb'at te' kaxa chi' yet' k'apak mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová yet' masanil yamk'ab' ayoch t'a yo'ol chi'.

Haxo winhaj Salomón chi' yet' masanil heb' yetchonhab' Israel molanek' chi', ix b'ab'laj heb' t'a yichanh te' kaxa chi'. Yakb'an wan sb'at heb', manhxo b'ischajb'enok jantak nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax ix yak' heb' silab'ok t'a Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anb'at te' kaxa chi' heb' sacerdote t'a yol templo masanto t'a yol jun lugar Yiknhej Jehová Yaji, t'a snanhal chab' yechel querubín.
Jenhanb'at sk'axil chab' yechel querubín chi' t'a yib'anh b'aj ix ak'jioch te' kaxa chi'. Ha sk'axil heb' ayoch yenhulok te' kaxa chi' yet' te' sb'akhnub'al.

Ha te' regla ayoch sb'akhlab'ilok te' kaxa chi', najat ste'el te'. Scheklajelul snhi' te' t'a junxo cuarto ay t'a satelta, palta manhxo chekeloklaj te' t'a stieli. Hata' ix kanxonhej te' kaxa chi' t'a junelnhej.

Malaj junokxo tas ayem t'a yol te' kaxa chi', anhej wal chab' pachanh k'e'en k'e'en yak'nakkanem winhaj Moisés t'a yol te' t'a Horeb, haton k'e'en b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkanoch strato Jehová yet' heb' israel ayik yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto.
Ayik ix elixta heb' sacerdote t'a yol templo chi', ix b'ut'jiel yol chi' yuj yasunal stzikikial Jehová. Ha yuj jun asun chi', majxo yal-laj smunlaj heb' t'a yo'ol chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix lesalwi winhaj rey Salomón, ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ix ala' to t'a skal k'ik' k'inal ayach.
Palta ix in b'ok'e jun a pat b'aj wach' tzach aji. Ix in b'o jun a pat yik tzach kajnaj t'ay t'a junelnhej, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajb'at k'elan winh rey chi' t'a masanil heb' israel linhjab'och ta', ix sk'anan swach'k'olal Dios winh t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh: Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, yujto toxo ix elk'och tas yalnakkan t'a winh in mam winhaj rey David.

Ayik yalannak icha tik: Atax wik'annakelta heb' in chonhab' t'a Egipto, mantalaj b'aj tzin sik'el junok chonhab' t'a he kal b'aj sb'ojik'e junok in pat b'aj tzin kajnaji. Anhej winhaj David ix in sik'eli yik tz'och winh reyal t'a skal heb' in chonhab' Israel tik, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ha winh in mam chi', snib'ejnak winh sb'ok'e junok templo yuj sniwanil yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal.
Palta yalnak Jehová t'a winh icha tik: Ha jun tza na' chi' te wach', tza b'ok'e junok in pat halani,
palta manhokachlaj ol a b'ok'ei, hato junok uninal ol b'oank'eok, xchi t'a winh.

Yuj chi', a tiknaik tz'elk'och tas yalnak Jehová chi'. Icha wal ajnak yalan chi', icha wal chi' ix aj yelk'ochi. Ha in ix in ochkan sk'exulok winh in mam chi', ix in och sreyalok ko chonhab' tik, yuj chi' ix in b'ok'e jun templo b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'a Jehová ko Diosal.
Ha t'a yo'ol chi' ix in b'okan jun lugar b'aj tz'aj te' skaxail trato sb'onak Jehová yet' heb' ko mam kicham ayik yik'annakelta heb' t'a Egipto, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och linhan winh t'a stz'ey yaltar Jehová t'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab' israel, ix yik'ancha'anh sk'ab' winh,

ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, malaj junokxo Dios lajan het'ok t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a sat lu'um tik, yujto tzak'elk'och a trato. Tzak'an a wach'k'olal t'a mach sk'anab'ajan t'a smasanil sk'o'ol tas tzala'.
Toxo ix ak'elk'och tas alnakkan t'a winh in mam winh a chekab' aj David. Manh tonhejok alnak, palta ha t'a jun k'u tik ix elk'och tas alnakkan chi'.

Yuj wal chi', Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, elokab'k'och tas alnak t'a winh in mam chi' to aynhej yinhtilal winh ol och t'a yol sdespacho, anhej tato tzach sk'anab'ajej heb', icha wal ajnak sk'anab'ajan winh in mam chi'.
Ha tiknaik jun, ach Jehová ko Diosal, elokab'k'och tas alnakkan t'a winh a chekab' chi'.
Palta, ¿yel am wal Mamin ol ach kajnaj t'a sat lu'um tik? Ina to max yab'laj satcha'anh b'aj syal a kajnaji, okxom wal jab' pat ix in b'ok'e tik t'ayach.
Wach'chom icha chi' ach in Diosal, palta maklej ab' in lesal yet' tas tzin k'an t'ayach, ab' tas swal t'ayach a in a chekab' in tik.
Tzin k'an wal t'ayach to max ik'el a sat t'a junjun k'u yet' t'a junjun ak'wal t'a templo tik, jun ix ala' to a t'ay ol ach b'inajok.

Maklej wal in lesal a in a chekab' in tik yet' yik heb' a chonhab' tik. Ayik tzonh lesalwi t'ayach tzonh kot k'elan t'a stojolal jun a templo tik, komonok tzab' t'a satcha'anh b'aj kajan ach, tzak'an lajwok ko chukal t'a kib'anh.
K'inalok ay junok mach tz'ak'jioch t'a yib'anh to ix och smul t'a junok yetanimail, tz'ik'jikoti yik syak'an sti' t'a yichanh altar t'a jun templo tik,

komonok tzab' t'a satcha'anh, tza ch'olb'itan t'a stojolal mach ay smul, tom a jun mach tz'ak'jioch t'a yib'anh chi', mato a jun mach tz'ak'anoch t'a yib'anh chi'. Ha achokab' tzak' sya'elal jun mach ay smul chi', haxo pax jun mach malaj smul chi' jun, a achokab' tzak' cheklajok to malaj smul.
K'inalok ay b'aj tzonh yak' ganar heb' kajk'o'ol yujto ix och ko mul t'ayach, tato sko na ko b'a, skalan ko b'a t'ayach, sko k'anan niwank'olal ko b'a t'ayach t'a jun a templo tik,
komonok tzab' t'a satcha'anh, tzak'an niwank'olal ko mul. Tzak'an meltzaj heb' tz'ik'jib'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a ko lu'um tik, haton lum ak'nakkan t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

K'inalok maxtzak yak' nhab' yujto ix och ko mul t'ayach, palta tato elanhchamel tzonh lesalwi t'ayach t'a stojolal jun templo tik, skalan ko b'a t'ayach, sko na'an ko b'a yuj ko mul chi' yuj ya'elal tz'och t'a kib'anh chi',

komonok tzab' t'a satcha'anh tas skal a onh a chekab' onh tik to a chonhab' onh. Tzak'an lajwok ko mul chi', tza ch'oxan junok b'eyb'al wach' yik sko b'eyb'alej. Slajwi chi' jun, tzak'ankot nhab' t'a yib'anh lum lum ix ak' t'ayonh a chonhab' onh tik.

K'inalok sjawi wejel t'a ko lu'um tik, ma junok ilya, ma stakjiel tastak yuj k'ak', ma sjawi nok' k'ulub', ma junokxo makan nok' nok' t'a kawb'en, ma tz'em tz'aub' t'ay, ma sjawi hoyan heb' ajk'ol t'a ko chonhab' tik, ma junokxo yalnhej tas sjawi t'a kib'anh,

sko nib'ej to tzab' tas sko k'an a onh a chonhab' onh tik. Ma yalnhej mach tz'awaj t'ayach yujto snachajel ku'uj to wan kab'an sya'il yuj ko mul, ayik sko mojb'ankot ko k'ab' t'a stojolal jun templo tik, komonok tzab' ko lesal chi' t'a satcha'anh b'aj ayach. Tzak'an tup ko mul, tzonh a kolani yet' onh a ch'olb'itani, haxo ak'an spak chi' t'ayonh hato syala' tas kaji, yujto ojtak tas ay t'a ko pensar junjun onh.
Tato icha chi', ol ach ko k'anab'ajej ko masanil yakb'an pitzan onh t'a sat lum lum ak'nak tik t'a heb' ko mam kicham.

Ol yab'nhej heb' ch'ok chonhab'il sniwanil elk'ochi yet' jantak a wach'k'olal tzak' t'ayonh a onh a chonhab' onh tik, yuj chi' ay heb' ol jawok yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'ayach. K'inalok ay junok heb' skot t'a najat yik syak'an lesal t'a stojolal jun templo tik,

komonok tzab' tas syal chi' t'a satcha'anh b'aj ayach. Tzak'an tas sk'ana' yik wach' tzach yojtakejel masanil chonhab', tzach sk'anab'ajan heb' icha tz'aj ach ko k'anab'ajan a onh a chonhab' onh tik. Icha chi' snachajel yuj heb' to a jun templo ix in b'ok'e tik iko'.

K'inalok a onh a chonhab' onh tik tzonh b'at kak' owal yet' heb' kajk'o'ol, yalnhej b'ajtil tzonh a chekb'ati, tato tzonh lesalwi t'ayach t'a stojolal jun a chonhab' sik'b'ilel tik u'uj yet' t'a stojolal jun templo ix in b'okank'e tik t'ayach,
komonok tzab' ko lesal chi' t'a satcha'anh, tzak'anelk'och tas sko k'an chi'.

Ayik ol och ko mul t'ayach a onh a chonhab' onh tik, (yujto malaj junok anima max och smul), ol onh ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol, tzonh yik'anb'at heb' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il t'a lak'an, ma najat yuj yowal a k'o'ol.

Tato sko na ko b'a t'a smasanil ko k'o'ol yet' ko pensar, ayik ayonhek' t'a juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il chi', tato sko k'an niwank'olal ko b'a t'ayach yujto snachajel ku'uj to ix och ko mul, haxo tzonh lesalwikot t'a stojolal lum lum ak'nak t'a heb' ko mam kicham, haton jun chonhab' sik'b'ilel uj b'aj ix in b'ok'e jun templo tik t'ayach,
komonok tzab' ko lesal yet' tas sko k'an t'ayach b'aj ayach ek' t'a satcha'anh chi', tza b'oan yaj t'ayonh.

Tzak'an lajwok ko mul tz'och t'ayach yet' ko pital a onh a chonhab' onh tik. Tza k'exan spensar heb' tzonh ik'anb'at chi' yik tz'ok' sk'ol heb' t'ayonh, yujto a chonhab' kaji, ik onh. Ha ach ik'nak onh elta t'a Egipto b'aj ayonh och t'a sya'elal.
Yuj chi' jun Mamin, ab' wal in lesal a in a chekab' in tik yet' slesal heb' wetchonhab' israel tik yujto ik onh. Maklej wal ab' Mamin Jehová ayik tzonh lesalwi t'ayach.

Yujto a ach onh a sik'nakel t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yik tzonh ochkan ikok, icha wal utej a chekannak yal winh a chekab' aj Moisés, ayik ik'annakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto, xchi winhaj Salomón chi' t'a slesal.
Kumanem winh t'a stz'ey altar, ayk'e sk'ab' winh t'a satcha'anh ayik ix lesalwi winh chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e wa'an winh, ix yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh heb' yetisraelal chi', te cha'anh ix yal winh icha tik:
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ix ak'an junk'olal t'ayonh, icha ajnak yalankani. Masanil tas wach' yalnakkan ku'uj t'a winhaj Moisés schekab', ix elk'ochi.
Aynhejokab' ek' Jehová ko Diosal ket'ok, icha ajnak ek' yet' heb' ko mam kicham. Malajokab' b'ak'inh tzonh yaktejkan ko ch'okoj.
Yak'okab'och Jehová t'a ko pensar to sko k'anab'ajej sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il, haton juntzanh scheknak sk'anab'ajej heb' ko mam kicham.
Masanil tas ix in k'an t'a Jehová ko Diosal, na'annhejokab' yuj t'a masanil tiempo. Aokab' tzin tanhwan a in schekab' in tik yet' a onh schonhab' onh tik yalnhej tas sjawi t'a kib'anh t'a junjun k'u,
yik wach' syojtakejel masanil chonhab' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik to a Jehová anhej Dios, malaj junokxo.
Yuj chi', anhejokab' t'a Jehová b'aj skak'och ko k'o'ol, sko k'anab'ajan sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il, icha sko k'ulej tiknaik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an silab' winh yet' masanil chonhab' Israel t'a Jehová.

Ay 22 mil nok' wakax yet' 120 mil nok' kalnel ix yak' winh silab'il t'a Dios yuj sch'oxan sjunk'olal yet'ok. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan jun templo chi' t'a yopisio yuj winhaj Salomón chi' yet' masanil chonhab'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix sik'kanel snanhal yol yamak'il templo winh rey chi' yik snhusjitz'a nok' silab', sat awb'en tz'ak'ji ofrendail yet' xepu'al nok' silab' yik sch'oxan sjunk'olal heb' yet' Jehová, yujto a jun altar nab'a bronce ay t'a yamak'il templo chi', max yab'laj yujto te niwan juntzanh silab' chi' tz'ak'ji.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', uke' k'ual ix och k'inh yuj winhaj rey Salomón chi' yet' masanil chonhab' t'a yichanh Jehová. Te tzijtum anima ix molchaji. Ix laj kot heb' t'a masanil yol smakb'en Israel, wach'chom te najat ichato t'a smojonal Hamat t'a norte masanto pax t'a ha ha' smojonal yet' Egipto t'a sur. Ayik ix lajwi uke' k'ual k'inh chinama chi', ix scha'anel yich ukexo k'ual k'inh chi' heb', yuj chi' chab' semana ix yak' k'inh chi' heb'.

Haxo yik ix lajwi k'inh chi' jun, ix tak'ajkan heb' anima chi' yuj winhaj rey Salomón chi'. Ix yalanpax wach' lolonel heb' t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix pax heb' t'a spat. Ix te tzalaj heb' yuj masanil tas wach' ix sk'ulej Jehová yet' winh schekab' aj David yet' heb' schonhab' Israel.
Ayik ix lajwi sb'oel stemplo Jehová yuj winhaj rey Salomón chi' yet' spalacio winh yet' pax juntzanhxo tas snib'ej winh sb'o'o,
ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Jehová t'a winh t'a schaelal, icha aj sch'oxan sb'a t'a winh t'a chonhab' Gabaón.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh: Ix wab' tas ix al t'a a lesal yet' masanil tas ix a k'ana'. Ix wak'kanoch jun templo ix a b'o tik wikok yik wach' a t'ay ol ochnhej ejmelal t'ayin. Ol in tanhwejnhej jun templo tik, ol in ajnhej ek' t'ay t'a masanil tiempo.

Yuj chi', tato wach'nhej ol utej a b'a t'ayin t'a smasanil a k'o'ol, icha yutejnak sb'a winhaj David a mam, tato tzin ak'och yipok a k'o'ol, tojolnhej tzutej a b'a, tza k'anab'ajan masanil tas ix wak' a k'ulej, tza k'anab'ajan in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il,
a opisio tik ol b'eynhejb'at t'a heb' inhtilal icha ajnak walan t'a winh a mam chi', ayik walannak t'a winh icha tik: Aynhej inhtilal ol och reyal t'a skal heb' chonhab' israel, xin chi t'a winh.

Palta tato a ach tik yet' heb' inhtilal ol eyik'el he b'a t'a in patik, manh ol he k'anab'ajej in cheknab'il yet' in k'ayb'ub'al ix wak' he k'anab'ajej, haxo t'a komon Dios ol ex och ejmelal, ol eyalan he b'a t'ay,
ol ex wik'el t'a sat lum lum wak'nak tik t'ayex. Haxo jun templo ix in sik'kanoch wikok tik, ol in patikejkaneli, ol ex b'uchjok yuj masanil nación.

Ha jun templo te wach' yilji tik tiknaik, toxonhej ol k'ekan juyan k'e'en sk'e'enal. Yuj chi' a heb' ol ek' t'a stz'ey, ol stzetzej heb', ol laj yal-lan heb' t'ay junjun: ¿Tas yuj icha tik ix utaj jun chonhab' yet' jun templo tik yuj Jehová? xcham heb'.

Haxo ol yalan heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha heb' israel tik, ix yik'el sb'a heb' t'a spatik Jehová sDiosal, haton jun ik'annakelta heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto. Haxo tiknaik a juntzanh komon Dios ix yak'och heb' t'a sk'o'ol, ix ochpax heb' ejmelal t'ay, yuj chi' a sDiosal heb' chi' ix ak'ankot jun chukal tik t'a yib'anh heb', xcham heb' anima chi', xchi Jehová t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.
Ha winhaj Salomón chi', 20 ab'il ix yak' winh sb'oank'e chab' niwak pat, haton stemplo Jehová yet' pax spalacio winh.

Ha winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro ix ak'ankot ste'al juntzanh pat chi', haton te' k'ute', te' taj yet' jantak k'e'en oro ix och t'ay. Yuj chi' 20 chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Galaad ix yak' winhaj Salomón t'a winhaj Hiram chi'.
Ayik ix xit'ek' winhaj Hiram chi' yil juntzanh chonhab' chi', maj schalaj sk'o'ol winh.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ach wamigo, ¿tas chonhab'il juntzanh ix ak' tik t'ayin? xchi winh. Yuj chi' a jun makan lum lum t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', Cabul ix yak' winhaj Hiram chi' sb'iej lu'um, syalelk'ochi “Malaj wach' yochi”.
Haxo jantak k'e'en oro ix yak' winhaj Hiram t'a winhaj Salomón chi' jun, ay am 90 quintalok k'e'en.

Ha winhaj rey Salomón chi', ix yak' wal pural winh yoch heb' yinhtilal heb' cananeo t'a munlajel, haton heb' maj yal satjiel yuj heb' israel ayik sjawinak heb' t'a Canaán chi'. Ha heb' chi' haton heb' amorreo, heb' hitita, heb' ferezeo, heb' heveo yet' heb' jebuseo. Ha juntzanh anima chi', chekab' yaj heb', manh yikoklaj sb'a heb'. Yuj smunlajel heb' ix sb'ok'e spalacio winh rey chi' yet' stemplo Jehová. Ix sb'oanpaxk'e smuroal Jerusalén heb'. Ix swach' b'oan juntzanhxo chonhab' heb', haton Hazor, Meguido yet' Gezer yik syal skolan sb'a heb' t'a owal. (Ha t'a yalanhtaxo a winh sreyal Egipto yak'nak owal winh t'a chonhab' Gezer chi', yak'annak ganar winh. Masanil heb' cananeo kajan ta' smilnakcham winh, snhusannakpaxtz'a chonhab' chi' winh. Ha jun chonhab' chi' ix yak' winh t'a ix yisil ayik ix yik'lan sb'a ix yet' winhaj Salomón chi'. Haxo winhaj Salomón chi' ix b'oanxik'e yuj smunlajel heb' cananeo chi'.) Ix sb'oanpaxk'e chonhab' Bet-horón heb' t'a yalanh yet' Baalat yet' Tadmor ay t'a tzinan lum t'a yol yik Judá yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' b'aj smolchajkan tas tz'ab'laji yet' juntzanh chonhab' b'aj ay nok' chej stok'an carruaje yik owal. Ix sb'oanpaxk'e masanil juntzanhxo tas heb' ix schek winhaj Salomón sb'o heb' t'a Jerusalén, t'a Líbano yet' t'a smasanil yol smakb'en Israel chi'. Hanhejtona' a heb' ix b'ut'an jun ch'olan t'a stojolal b'aj sk'eul k'u t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix sb'o jun tik heb' ayik toxo ix el ix yisil winh sreyal Egipto, ix yetb'eyum winhaj Salomón t'a yol schonhab'kan winhaj David, ix b'at kajnaj ix t'a spat ix sb'ok'e winhaj Salomón chi'. Maj yak'laj pural heb' yetisraelal winhaj Salomón chi' smunlaji. Ha tas ix sk'ulej heb', 550 heb' ix ak'jioch yil juntzanh munlajel chi'. Ix och heb' yajalil yet' winhaj Salomón chi', ix ochpax heb' sat yajalil t'a heb' soldado, yajalil t'a carruaje yik owal yet' t'a heb' soldado sk'e t'a yib'anh chej.

Oxtakel syak' silab' winhaj rey Salomón chi' t'a Jehová t'a junjun ab'il, haton silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil yet' silab' yik junk'olal yet' Dios. Ha t'a altar ix sb'ok'e winh yikok Jehová, hata' ix yak' silab' chi' winh. Ix schekanpax winh nhusjoktz'a incienso t'a yichanh Jehová ayik ix lajwi sb'oel jun templo chi'.
Ix schekanpax winh b'ojok juntzanh te' barco t'a Ezión-geber t'a slak'anil Elat, t'a sti' ha' Chakchak Mar t'a yol yik Edom.
Ha winhaj rey Hiram ix chekankot juntzanh heb' smunlajwum, haton heb' te k'aynak yek' t'a yib'anh ha' mar. Ix b'at heb' t'a yol te' barco chi' yet' heb' smunlajwum winhaj rey Salomón chi'.
Ix k'och heb' t'a Ofir, hata' ix yik'kot 310 quintal k'e'en oro heb' t'a winhaj rey Salomón chi'.

Ha ix sreinail chonhab' Sabá, ix yab' spekal ix to te b'inajnak winhaj rey Salomón yuj sjelanil syak' Jehová. Yuj chi' ix jawi ix t'a Jerusalén, yik syilan ix tato syal spakan juntzanh tas ajaltak sk'anb'ej ix t'a winh. Tzijtum heb' schekab' ix yet'nak, yet'nakpax nok' camello ix. Al yaj nok' t'a perfume, t'a k'e'en oro yet' t'a juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yilji. Ayik ix jawi ix t'a yichanh winhaj rey Salomón chi', ix sk'anb'an ix tas snib'ej sk'anb'ej chi' t'a winh.
Ix spakan winh masanil tas ix sk'anb'ej ix chi', malaj wal junok tas sk'anb'ej ix chi' to maj nachaj spakan winh.

Ix te sat sk'ol ix ayik ix yilan ix jantak sjelanil winh, yuj spalacio winh b'ob'il yuj, yuj pax tas swa winh t'a smexa yet' b'aj kajan heb' ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh. Ch'okxo yilji pax spichul heb' schekab' winh, heb' sb'akhumalkot skopa winh yet' juntzanh silab' snhustz'a winh t'a stemplo Jehová. Ayik ix yilan juntzanh chi' ix, ix te sat sk'o'ol ix.
Yuj chi' ix yal ix t'a winhaj Salomón chi' icha tik: Ha tas ix wab' spekal t'a in chonhab' yuj masanil tastak tza k'ulej yet' a jelanil sb'inaji, a juntzanh chi' te yel.

Ayik manto wil juntzanh tik, max in chalaj wab'i, haxo tiknaik ix wil yet' in sat, max k'ochlaj nanhal juntzanh tik ix alji wab'i. Ha a jelanil yet' masanil tas ay t'ayach, yelxo wal ek'to t'a yichanh icha tas ix wab' chi'.
Te wach' yik heb' anima smunlaj t'ayach, te wach' pax yik heb' a chekab' ayek' het'ok yik syab'an a jelanil heb'.

Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová a Diosal, stzalaj het'ok yuj chi' ix yak' smakb'en Israel tik t'ayach. Yujto te xajan chonhab' Israel tik yuj Jehová, yuj chi' ix ach yak'och reyal yik tzak'an yajalil t'a stojolal yet' t'a swach'il, xchi ix reina chi' t'a winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an 90 quintal k'e'en oro ix, jantak perfume yet' k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yilji t'a winhaj rey Salomón chi'. Manhxa junelok ix jawi perfume t'a Israel icha jantak ix yak' ix t'a winh rey chi'.

Haxo winh rey chi' ix ak'anpax masanil tas ix sk'an ix sreinail Sabá chi', ch'ok pax tas ix el t'a sk'ol winh yak'an t'a ix. Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzaj ix t'a schonhab' yet' heb' schekab' ajun yet'ok. Ay pax juntzanhxo tastak ix ik'jikot t'a yol te' sbarco winhaj rey Hiram, ix yik'kot k'e'en oro heb' t'a chonhab' Ofir. Manhxo jantakok te te' sándalo sb'i yet' k'e'en k'e'en te wach' yilji. Ha te' waranda ix och t'a stemplo Jehová yet' te' ix och t'a spalacio winhaj Salomón chi', ha t'a te' sándalo chi' ix yak' b'ojok te' winh. Ix b'ojipax te' arpa t'a te' yet' salterio yik heb' sb'itani. Manhxa junelokxo ix jawi jantak te' sándalo icha te' ix jawi junel chi'.
Ha k'e'en oro scha winhaj rey Salomón t'a junjun ab'il, 500 quintal k'e'en.
Ch'ok pax yaj k'e'en syak' heb' chonhwajum yet' pax k'e'en syak' heb' winh sreyal Arabia yet' heb' yajal t'a yol smakb'en Israel chi'.
Ix schek winh rey chi' b'ojok 200 niwak jenhan oro maklab' jul-lab', ay am lajchaweok libra k'e'en oro ix och t'a junjun.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanpax b'ojok 300-xo kotak smaklab'il jul-lab' chi' winh, ay am wakeok libra k'e'en oro ix och t'a junjun. Ix yak'och juntzanh chi' winh t'a yol jun pat skuchan Spatil Te te' yik Líbano.
Ix schekanpax winh b'ojok jun sk'ojnub' t'a sdespacho, ix ak'jioch k'e'en oro te wach' t'ay, ix ak'jipaxoch marfil yelwanub'ok.

Ha jun k'ojnub' chi', wak tzol sk'e sb'akhkiltakil sk'o'ochal. Ay lajchawe' yechel nok' choj aykan t'a stitak jun k'o'och chi', wake' nok' t'a junjun stitak. Ha yelaw yich spatik jun k'ojnub' chi', setansetan yaji. Ha sk'ab' t'a junjun stz'eytak, ayoch junjun yechel nok' choj t'ay. Malaj junokxo rey b'oannak junok sk'ojnub' icha jun chi'.

Ha skopa winh rey chi', nab'a oro smasanil yet' jantak xalu yet' chen sk'anchaj t'a jun pat skuchan Spatil Te te' yik Líbano. Malaj junok yamk'ab' chi' plata, yujto ha t'a stiempoal winhaj rey Salomón chi', a k'e'en plata chi' malaj yelk'och k'e'en.

Ha winhaj Salomón chi', ay juntzanh te' sniwak barco winh tzek' yet' juntzanh te' yik winhaj Hiram. T'a junjun yoxil ab'il sjawi heb' schekab' winh yet' te' barco chi', yet'nak k'e'en oro heb', k'e'en plata, marfil, nok' chab'in yet' nok' pawo real.
Icha chi' ix aj ste k'echa'anh winhaj rey Salomón chi' yuj sjelanil yet' sb'eyumal t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' rey t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Masanil juntzanh chonhab', snib'ej heb' syila' yet' yab'an jantak sjelanil winh ix ak'ji yuj Dios.
Ha heb' anima sjawi t'a junjun ab'il, syik'kot juntzanh silab' tik heb': K'en plata, k'e'en oro, pichul caro stojol, yamk'ab' yik owal, juntzanh suk'uk'i sjab', nok' chej yet' nok' mula.

Ix smolb'an jantak carruaje yik owal yet' nok' chej winhaj Salomón chi'. Ay mil 400 carruaje yet' 12 mil nok' chej sk'e heb' soldado t'a yib'anh. Ay carruaje yet' nok' chej chi' ayek' t'a juntzanh chonhab' to yiktaxon juntzanh chi' yaji. Ay pax juntzanhxo carruaje chi' ayek' yet' heb' soldado stanhwan winh rey chi' t'a Jerusalén.

Manhxo jantakok k'e'en plata ix smolb'ej winh rey chi' t'a Jerusalén chi', icha wal k'e'en komon k'e'en. Manhxo jantakok pax te' k'ute', icha te' kaltakte'al higo ay t'a spanhanil yichtak witz, icha chi' yaj te'.
Ha nok' schej winh rey chi', ha t'a Egipto skot nok' yet' t'a Cilicia, yujto a heb' schonhwajum winh, a heb' smanankot nok' ta'.

Ha junok carruaje smanchajkot t'a Egipto, 600 siclos plata stojol, haxo junok nok' chej, 150 siclos stojol nok'. Ha heb' winh sreyal hitita yet' heb' winh sreyal sirio smananpax nok' t'a heb' schonhwajum winhaj rey Salomón chi'.

Ha winhaj rey Salomón chi', manhoknhej ix yisil winh sreyal Egipto chi' ix yik' winh, palta ayto juntzanhxo heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il ix yik' winh, haton heb' ix moabita, heb' ix amonita, heb' ix edomita, heb' ix aj Sidón yet' heb' ix hitita.

Yalnak Jehová to ay yowalil yik'lan sb'a heb' israel yet' juntzanh heb' ix chi', yik max montajb'at heb' yuj heb' ix t'a spatik juntzanh skomon diosal schonhab' heb' ix chi'. Palta haxo winhaj rey Salomón chi', ix kan snib'ej winh t'a heb' ix, ix yik'lan sb'a winh yet' heb' ix.
Ay 700 heb' ix yetb'eyum winh chi', yisil rey heb' ix. Ay pax 300 heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh yaji. Ha yuj heb' ix chi' ix juwiel spensar winh.

Haxo yik ix ichamwinakax winh, ix somchajb'at spensar winh yuj heb' ix. Ix montajb'at winh t'a spatik juntzanhxo komon Dios. Majxo yak'och spensar winh sik'lab'il t'a Jehová sDiosal icha yutejnak sb'a winhaj David smam winh.
Ix och winh ejmelal t'a jun komon Dios skuch Astoret, ix sdiosal heb' aj Sidón yet' t'a junxo komon Dios skuch Milcom, sdiosal heb' amonita. Ha juntzanh chi' te yajb'ilel yuj Jehová.
Yuj chi', te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová chi', yujto manh k'anab'ajumoklaj ix yutej sb'a winh t'ay, manh lajanoklaj ix yutej sb'a winh icha yutejnak sb'a winh smam chi'.

Ha t'a jun tzalan t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Jerusalén, hata' ix sb'ok'e stemplo sdiosal heb' moabita winh, haton jun skuchan Quemos. Ix sb'opax stemplo sdiosal heb' amonita winh, haton jun skuch Moloc. Ha juntzanh komon Dios chi' yajb'ilel yuj Jehová.
Ichanhej chi' ix sk'ulej winh yet' masanil heb' ix ix ch'ok chonhab'il ix yik'a', yik syak' silab' heb' ix yet' incienso t'a sdiosal junjun.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal Jehová sDiosal Israel t'a winhaj Salomón chi', yujto ix patikajkanel yuj winh, wach'chom chael sch'oxnak sb'a t'a winh.
Ix yal Jehová t'a winh to ay yowalil yoch ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, palta maj sk'anab'ajej winh sk'ulan tas ix yal Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: Yujto icha tik ix a k'ulej, maj a k'anab'ajej in trato yet' in cheknab'il walnak t'ayach, yuj chi' ol wik'ek' opisio tik, ol wak'an t'a junok heb' a chekab'.
Palta yujto xajan winh a mam wu'uj, yuj chi' yakb'an pitzanachto, manh ol wik'ek'laj opisio tik, palta ha t'a jun uninal, hata' ol wik'ek'i.
Manh ol wik'ek' yopisio chi' smasanil. Olto kan junok makan t'a yol sk'ab' yujto xajan winh in chekab' aj David wu'uj yet' chonhab' Jerusalén tik, yujto sik'b'ilel wu'uj, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi' a Jehová ix ak'ankot jun winh ajk'o'ol t'a winhaj Salomón chi', haton winhaj Hadad yinhtilalkan heb' winh sreyal Edom.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, ayik yak'annak ganar chonhab' Edom chi' winhaj rey David, a winhaj Joab yajalil heb' soldado b'at yet' jun makan heb' soldado Israel, yik b'at smukan heb' chamnak heb', wake' ujal kan heb' ta'. Yakb'an chi', swach' milancham masanil heb' winh winak aj Edom chi' heb'.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', yune' kelemto winhaj Hadad chi', palta elkan lemnaj winh, b'atkan winh yet' juntzanh heb' schekab' winh smam, sb'atkan heb' t'a Egipto.

El heb' t'a Madián, sk'och heb' t'a Parán. Hata' yik'b'at juntzanhxo heb' winh winak heb', sk'ochkan heb' t'a winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Hata' ak'ji spat heb', swa'el heb' yet' slum heb' yuj winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Hadad chi', te wach' sna'an winh rey chi' t'a spatik winh, yuj chi' yak' jun ix smu' winh rey chi' yetb'eyumok winh, haton ix snulej ix reina Tahpenes.
Yalji jun yune' ix yet' winhaj Hadad chi', Genubat yak' ix sb'iej. Ha ix Tahpenes chi' ilan k'ib' jun unin chi' t'a spalacio winh rey chi', junnhej k'ib'nak yet' heb' yuninal winh rey chi'.

Haxo yik yab'an spekal winhaj Hadad t'a Egipto chi' to a winhaj rey David chamnakxo winh, chamnakxo pax winhaj Joab yajalil heb' soldado, yalan winh icha tik t'a winh sreyal Egipto chi': --Cha in meltzaj t'a in chonhab', xchi winh.

Stak'wi winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej tzach meltzaj t'a a chonhab' chi'? ¿Tom ay tas syak' palta t'ayach wu'uj? xchi winh. Stak'wi winhaj Hadad chi': --Tz'akan yaj masanil t'ayin u'uj, palta tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin a cha meltzajok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' chaji meltzaj winh yuj winh rey chi'. Ha winhaj Hadad chi' ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ay junxo winh skuchan Rezón yuninal winhaj Eliada, ha Dios ix ak'anoch t'a spensar winh, ix och winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj Salomón chi'. Ha winhaj Rezón chi' elnak lemnaj winh t'a winh sreyal, haton winhaj Hadad-ezer sreyal Soba.

Ayik yak'jinak ganar winhaj Hadad-ezer sreyal Soba chi' yet' smiljicham heb' soldado winh yuj winhaj rey David, a winhaj Rezón chi' smolb'ej jun nhilanh heb' elk'um winh, yoch winh yajalok heb'. Sb'atkan kajan winh yet' heb' soldado chi' t'a Damasco, hata' ak'jioch winh reyal yuj heb'.
Ix te och winh ajk'olal t'a chonhab' Israel ayik ayoch winhaj Salomón chi' reyal, icha ix yutej sb'a winhaj Hadad sreyal Edom.

Ay pax junxo winh ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winhaj Salomón chi', ix meltzajoch winh ajk'olal t'a winh. Haton winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat aj Sere t'a yinhtilal heb' Efraín. Chamnakxo smam winh chi', haxo ix snun winh, Serúa sb'i ix.
Icha wal tik ix aj spitzwicha'anh owal yuj winh: Ha winhaj rey Salomón chi' ix chekan b'ut'jok jun ch'olan yik wach' schalaj sb'a smuroal schonhab' winhaj rey David.
Ha winhaj Jeroboam chi' te nhikan winh, ayik ix yilan winh rey chi' to te ay yelk'och winh t'a sat heb' yetchonhab', ix yak'anoch winh yajalil t'a heb' munlajwum yinhtilalkan José.

Ha junel ix elta winhaj Jeroboam chi' t'a stiel Jerusalén chi', k'okb'il ix schalaj sb'a winh yet' winhaj Ahías schekab' Dios, aj Silo. Ayoch jun sjukan pichul winhaj Ahías chi', te ak'to. Ix lolon heb' winh sch'okoj schawanhil.
Ix yik'anel jun sjukan pichul winhaj Ahías chi', lajchawe' ix yutej winh snhik'chitanb'ati.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Jeroboam chi' icha tik: Cha lajunheok iko', yujto icha tik syal Jehová ko Diosal t'ayach: Ol wik'ek' smakb'en winhaj Salomón, haxo t'ayach ol wak' lajunheok inhtilal.
Palta yujto xajan winh in chekab' aj David wu'uj yet' pax chonhab' Jerusalén sik'b'ilel wu'uj t'a skal masanil chonhab' Israel, yuj chi' olto wak'kan junok inhtilal t'a yinhtilal winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ha winhaj Salomón chi' ix in yaktejkan winh, ix och winh ejmelal t'a Astarté, ix sdiosal heb' aj Sidón yet' t'a Quemos sdiosal heb' moabita yet' t'a Milcom sdiosal heb' amonita. Te manhxa swach'il tas syutej sb'a winh t'a wichanh, maxtzak sk'anab'ajej in k'ayb'ub'al winh yet' in cheknab'il. Manh ichok yutejnak sb'a winhaj David smam winh, manh ichokta' syutej sb'a winh.

Palta yakb'an pitzanto winh, manh ol wik'ek'laj yopisio winh tik t'a reyal. Yujto xajan winh in chekab' aj David wu'uj to in sik'nakel winh, sk'anab'ajejnak wal in cheknab'il winh yet' in k'ayb'ub'al.
Palta ha t'a jun winh yuninal winhaj Salomón chi' ol wik'ek' lajunheok inhtilal, ol wak'an t'ayach.
Junxonhej inhtilal ol wak'kan t'a winh yik wach' ayto mach ol na'ankot winh in chekab' aj David t'a wichanh t'a Jerusalén tik, haton jun chonhab' in sik'nakkanel b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'ayin.
Ol ach wak'och reyal t'a yib'anh tas tza nib'ej, haton chonhab' Israel.

Yuj chi', tato ol a k'anab'ajej masanil tas tzin chek a k'ulej tik, tato tojolnhej pax ol utej a b'a t'a wichanh, tato ol a k'anab'ajejnhej in k'ayb'ub'al yet' in cheknab'il, icha yutejnak sb'a winh in chekab' aj David, tato icha chi', ayinnhej ek' het'ok. Ol wak'nhej opisio, icha ajnak wak'an yopisio winh in chekab' aj David chi', ol wak'anoch chonhab' Israel tik t'a yol a k'ab'.
Ol wak'och ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal winhaj David junok tiempoal yujnhej smul winhaj Salomón chi', palta manh ol wak'kanochlaj t'a junelnhej, xchi Jehová t'ayach, xchi winhaj Ahías chi'.

Ha yuj tas ix yal Jehová chi', ix snib'ej winhaj Salomón smilcham winhaj Jeroboam chi'. Yuj chi' ix el lemnaj winh, ix b'atkan winh t'a Egipto b'aj ayoch winhaj Sisac reyal. Ix kannhej winh ta' masanto ix cham winhaj Salomón chi'.
Ha yab'ixal juntzanhxo tas sk'ulejnak winhaj Salomón chi' yet' sjelanil winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj tz'ib'ab'il yab'ixal winh.
Ha winhaj Salomón chi', 40 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén t'a yib'anh masanil chonhab' Israel.
Ayik ix cham winh, ix mukchaj winh t'a schonhab' winhaj David winh smam. Ixlajwi chi' haxo jun yuninal winh skuchan Roboam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ix b'at winhaj Roboam t'a Siquem, yujto hata' molanxo ek' masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel ay t'a stojolal norte yik syak'ankanoch winh heb' sreyalok.
Ix k'och spekal jun tik t'a winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat ayik ayek' winh t'a Egipto, yujto elnak lemnaj winh t'a winhaj rey Salomón chi'.
Ix schekan heb' israel chi' to b'at ik'chajkot winh. Haxo yik ix jawi winh, ix b'at winh yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal lolonel yet' winhaj Roboam chi'. Ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik:

--Ha winh a mam te ek'al ya munlajel ix yak' winh ko k'ulej. Haxo tiknaik jun, sko nib'ej to tzik'el jab'ok juntzanh munlajel te ya chi' t'a kib'anh, yik ol kak'och ko b'a t'a yalanh a mandar, xchi heb'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Roboam chi': --Ha tiknaik paxanhek, chab'ejto tzex jax in heyila', swalan t'ayex tas tz'aji, xchi winh t'a heb'. Ix pax heb' anima chi'.
