Ixlajwi chi', ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' munlajnak yet' winh smam winh chi' icha tik: --¿Tas wal junok razón tzeyak' t'ayin, yik tzin pakan slolonel heb' anima tik? xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh: --Tato tza nib'ej tzak' serwil jun chonhab' tik, wach' tzutej tak'wok a b'a t'a heb', yik wach' ol yak'nhejoch sb'a heb' t'a yalanh a mandar, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Palta maj schalaj yab' winh tas ix yal heb' winh ichamtak winak chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix sk'anb'anxi winh t'a juntzanh heb' winh kelemtak winak jun ix k'ib' winh yet'ok, heb' winh ix och t'a yopisio yet' winh.

Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas junok razón tzeyak' t'ayin, tas ol wutok in pakan slolonel heb' anima chi'? Snib'ej heb' swik'el jab'ok munlajel yet' juntzanhxo tas aykanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yuj winh in mam, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh kelemtak chi' t'a winh: --Ha heb' tz'alan chi' to tzik'el jab'ok munlajel aykanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yuj winh a mam chi', al t'a heb' icha tik: Ya munlajel b'aj yak'nak ex och winh in mam chi', a inxo pax tik, ek'alto sya'il b'aj ol ex wak'ochi.

Al yutejnak eyikatz winh in mam chi', a inxo pax tik, ek'alto ol wutej yalil eyikatz chi'. Ha winh in mam chi', anhej t'a nok' tz'u'um smak'nak ex winh, a inxo pax tik, a nok' tz'u'um ayoch k'e'en k'e'en t'a snhi' ol wak'lab'ej t'ayex, xa chi t'a heb', xchi heb' winh kelemtak chi'.
Haxo t'a schab'jial chi', ix jax winhaj Jeroboam yet' masanil heb' chonhab' israel yil winhaj rey Roboam chi', icha ix aj yalan winh.
Haxo winh rey chi', maj yal-laj winh icha ix aj yalan heb' winh ichamtak winak chi', palta te chuk ix yutej winh spakan t'a heb' chonhab' chi'.

Ha tas ix yal heb' winh kelemtak, a ix yal winh t'a heb', ix yalan winh icha tik: Al yutejnak eyikatz winh in mam chi', a inxo pax tik, ek'alto ol wutej yalil eyikatz chi'. Ha winh in mam chi', anhej t'a nok' tz'u'um smak'nak ex winh, a inxo pax tik, a nok' tz'u'um ayoch k'e'en k'e'en t'a snhi' ol wak'lab'ej t'ayex, xchi winh t'a heb' anima chi'.

Ayik ix yilan heb' israel chi' to maj schalaj yab' winh rey chi' tas ix yal heb', yuj chi' ix yalan heb' icha tik: Malaj kalan kik t'a yinhtilal winhaj David. Malaj junok makan onh tzonh kan yet' yinhtilal winhaj Isaí. Konh paxek t'a ko pat. Olxo yilkan sb'a winhaj David yet' yinhtilal tas sk'ulej, xchi heb'. Ix chekjib'at winhaj Adoram yuj winh rey chi' yik b'at lolon winh yet' heb' israel chi', yujto a winh ay yopisio skuchb'an heb' munlajwum yowalil smunlaji. Haxo heb' israel chi', ix k'e somnaj heb', ix sjulk'enancham winh heb'. Haxo yik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Roboam chi', ix k'e winh t'a yol scarruaje, ix kot lemnaj winh t'a Jerusalén. Ixlajwi chi', haxo masanil makanhil heb' israel ay t'a stojolal norte ix pax heb' t'a spat. Haxonhej t'a heb' kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá ix yak' reyal winhaj Roboam chi'. Ichaton chi' ix aj yik'anel sb'a heb' israel t'a yol sk'ab' yinhtilal winhaj David. Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan Jehová t'a winh schekab', haton winhaj Ahías aj Silo, yuj winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' israel to ayxo ek' winhaj Jeroboam t'a yol schonhab' heb', ix schekan heb' awtajkot winh yik sch'oxan sb'a winh t'a yichanh heb'. Ix yak'anoch winh heb' sreyalok. Haxonhej heb' yinhtilal Judá ix kan yet' winhaj Roboam yixchikin winhaj David.

Ayik ix jax winhaj Roboam t'a Jerusalén chi', ix smolb'an 180 mil heb' soldado winh t'a yinhtilal Judá yet' t'a yinhtilal Benjamín yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' yetisraelal yik smeltzajxioch heb' t'a yalanh smandar winh yalani.
Palta ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Semaías schekab' icha tik:
Al t'a winhaj Roboam yuninal winhaj Salomón, sreyal Judá yet' t'a masanil heb' yinhtilal Judá chi', t'a yinhtilal Benjamín yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' anima ayek' t'a skal heb':

Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Manh eyak' owal yet' heb' eyetisraelal chi', yujto a in ix el t'a in k'o'ol to icha chi' tz'aji. Meltzajanhek t'a he pat, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb', xchi t'a winh. Ayik ix yab'an heb' anima chi', ix meltzaj heb' icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ix swach' b'oank'e chonhab' Siquem winhaj Jeroboam chi', haton ay t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Hata' ix kajnaj winh. Ix sb'oanpaxk'e chonhab' Penuel winh.
Ix sna'an winh icha tik: Ha tiknaik tekan ol yik'xiek' in reyal tik jun winh yinhtilal winhaj David.

Tato ol b'atnhej heb' anima tik yak' silab' t'a stemplo Jehová t'a Jerusalén, axom yak'anxioch spensar heb' t'a winhaj Roboam sreyal Judá. Ol am in smilcham heb', ol am b'atkan heb' smasanil yet' winhaj Roboam chi', xchi winh.

Haxo yik ix lajwi slolon winh yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok, ix schekan winh b'ojok chab' yechel kelem wakax nab'a oro. Ix yalan winh t'a masanil anima icha tik: Ex wetisraelal, manhxo ex b'at t'a Jerusalén. Ajaltak he b'ati, ina wal ko diosal tik, haton ik'annak onh elta t'a Egipto, xchi winh t'a heb'.
Jun yechel wakax chi' ix yak'kan winh t'a chonhab' Betel, ix yak'ankan junxo winh t'a chonhab' Dan.
Ha yuj jun chi' ix och smul heb' anima chi', yujto ix b'at heb' t'a chonhab' Dan yak'em sb'a t'a jun yechel chi'.
Ix sb'oanpaxk'e spatil sdiosal winh chi' t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh. Ix yak'anoch yopisio heb' komon anima winh t'a sacerdoteal, manh levitaok heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'anoch jun k'inh winh t'a 15 yoch swajxakil uj yik jun ab'il chi' icha jun k'inh tzek' t'a Judá. Ix yak'ank'e silab' winh t'a yib'anh altar t'a jun yechel wakax ix sb'o winh chi' t'a chonhab' Betel. Ix yak'anpaxoch heb' sacerdote chi' winh yilumalok spatil sdiosal ix sb'o t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh.

Yuj chi' ha t'a 15 yoch swajxakil uj chi', ix yak'anoch jun k'inh chi' winh, munil ix snaelta winh t'a yol yiko'. Ix yak'an silab' winh t'a yib'anh altar ix sb'o t'a chonhab' Betel chi'. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix snhuspaxtz'a incienso winh t'a yib'anh altar chi'.
Ayik wan snhusantz'a incienso winhaj Jeroboam t'a yib'anh altar t'a chonhab' Betel, ix k'och jun winh schekab' Dios t'a winh ix kot t'a Judá.

Ha wal Jehová ix chekan winh, yuj chi' te ow ix yutej winh yalan t'a altar chi', ix yalan winh: Ha ex tzeyak'em he b'a t'a jun altar tik, a wal Jehová ix halani to ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj David ay jun unin ol aljok. Ha jun chi', Josías ol sb'iej. Ha winh ol milancham juntzanh heb' winh sacerdote yik komon Dios t'a yib'anh jun altar tik, haton heb' snhusan incienso t'a tik. Ol snhusanpaxtz'a sb'akil anima winh t'a yib'anh, xchi Jehová, xchi winh schekab' chi'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yal winh schekab' Dios chi' tas ol ujok yik sch'oxaneli to schekab' Jehová yaj winh. Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha jun altar tik ol pojb'atok, haxo k'e'en ta'anh ayek' t'a yib'anh tik, ol tob'kanb'at k'e'en, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Ayek' winhaj rey Jeroboam t'a stz'ey altar chi', ayik ix yab'an winh masanil tas ix yal winh schekab' Dios yuj jun altar chi', ix yak'anb'at jekan sk'ab' winh sch'oxan winh schekab' Dios chi', ix yalan winh: Yamec jun winh tik, xchi winh. Palta a sk'ab' winh ix b'at jekan chi', ix tzatzb'ikanel li'an, majxo yal-laj spakan sb'a.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix pojb'at jun altar chi', haxo jantak k'e'en ta'anh ay t'a yib'anh, ix tob'kanb'at k'e'en. Ix elk'och icha ix schek Jehová yal winh schekab' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winh schekab' Dios chi': Swal t'ayach to tzach tewi t'a Jehová a Diosal wu'uj, yik sb'oxikan in k'ab' tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winh chekab' chi' t'a Jehová, ix b'oxikan sk'ab' winh rey chi' ichataxon yaji.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh schekab' Dios chi': --Konh wet' t'a in pat, ol ach wa jab'ok yakb'an tzin b'o jab'ok tas ol in siej t'ayach, xchi winh.
Palta ix tak'wi winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Wach'chom nanhal tas ay t'ayach tzak' t'ayin, manh ol in b'atlaj het'ok, max yalpax in wa'i, ma wuk'an ha ha' t'a jun lugar tik.
Yujto a Jehová ix halan t'ayin icha tik: Malaj jab'ok tas ol a wa''a, manh ol uk'ejpax jab'ok ha ha', manh ol ach meltzaj t'a b'e b'aj ol ach b'atok, xchi t'ayin, xchi winh chekab' chi'.
Ch'okxo jun b'e b'aj ix meltzaj winh schekab' Dios chi', manhxo'oklaj t'a jun b'e b'aj ix k'och winh t'a Betel chi'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ay jun winh schekab' Dios te icham winakxo kajan t'a Betel chi'. Ha heb' yuninal winh ix halan t'ay tas ix sk'ulej winh schekab' Dios t'a Betel t'a jun k'u chi', haton winh ix kot t'a Judá. Ix yalanpax heb' t'a winh smam chi' tas ix yal winh chekab' chi' t'a winh rey chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh icham chi' t'a heb' yuninal chi' icha tik: --¿Tas b'eal b'aj ix b'at winh schekab' Dios chi'? xchi winh. Ix yalan heb' winh b'aja b'e b'aj ix b'at winh chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yuninal chi': --Hak'ekoch stz'um nok' in b'uru, xchi winh. Ixlajwi yoch stz'um nok' yuj heb', ix k'e winh t'a yib'anh nok',

ix b'at tzak'an winh t'a spatik winh schekab' Dios aj Judá chi'. Ix k'och winh t'a spatik winh ayik k'ojanem winh t'a yich jun te' mach', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh: --¿Tom a ach tik schekab' ach Dios ach kot t'a Judá? xchi winh. --Ha in toni, xchi.
--Konh wet' wa''el t'a in pat, xchi winh icham winak chi'.
Ix tak'wi winh schekab' Dios chi': Max yal-laj in b'ati yik tzin wa het'ok, ma wuk'an ha' et' t'a jun lugar tik.
Yujto icha tik ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayin: Malaj jab'ok tas ol a wa''a, manh ol uk'ejpax jab'ok ha ha', manh ol ach meltzaj t'a b'e b'aj ol ach b'atok, xchi t'ayin, xchi winh.

Palta ix yalanxi winh icham winak chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha in tik schekab' in pax Dios icha ach tik. Ha jun yángel Jehová ix halan t'ayin to tzach wik'b'at wa''el t'a in pat, swak'anpax ha' uk'ej, xchi winh. Palta tonhej ix yesej winh icham winak chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh schekab' Dios chi' yet' winh icham winak chi' t'a spat, ix wa winh, ix yuk'an ha' winh.
Wanto swa heb' winh, ix lolon Jehová t'a winh schekab' icham winakxo chi', ix yalani:
--Ix a pitej a b'a, maj a k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová t'ayach,

yujto ix ach meltzaji, ix ach wa'i, ix uk'anpax ha' t'a jun lugar b'aj ix yal Jehová to max yal-laj. Yuj chi' jun, manh ol mukchaj a niwanil b'aj mukan heb' a mam icham, xchi winh icham winak chi' t'a winh.
Ayik ix lajwi swa'i yet' yuk'an ha' winh schekab' Dios ix kot t'a Judá chi', ix yak'anoch stz'u'um jun nok' sb'uru winh icham winak chi', ix yak'an nok' winh t'a winh schekab' Dios chi'.

Ix pax winh schekab' Dios chi', palta haxo t'a yol b'e ix elta jun nok' choj t'a winh, ix miljicham winh yuj nok'. Hata' ix kan telan sniwanil winh, haxo nok' b'uru yet' nok' choj chi', ayek' nok' t'a stz'ey sniwanil winh chi'.

Ay juntzanh heb' winh winak ix ek' ta', ix yilan heb' winh to telanek' sniwanil jun chamnak t'a yol b'e chi', haxo nok' choj chi' ayek' nok' t'a stz'ey. Ix b'at heb' winh b'aj kajan winh icham winak schekab' Dios chi', ix yalan heb' winh tas ix yil heb' winh t'a yol b'e chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an winh icham winak chi', winh ix b'at ik'an meltzaj winh schekab' Dios t'a yol b'e chi', ix yalan winh: Haton winh schekab' Dios maj k'anab'ajan tas ix yal Dios chi', yuj chi' ix ak'jioch winh t'a yol sk'ab' nok' choj chi', ix tzilchitajb'at winh yuj nok', icha ix aj yalan Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' yuninal to syak'och stz'u'um junok nok' b'uru heb'. Ix yak'anoch stz'u'um nok' heb'.

Ix b'at winh icham winak chi', ix k'och winh b'aj telan ek' sniwanil winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a yol b'e chi'. Ha nok' b'uru yet' nok' choj chi', ayek' nok' t'a stz'ey sniwanil winh chi'. Mantalaj jab'ok sniwanil winh schi nok' choj chi', malaj pax ix utaj nok' b'uru chi' yuj nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ank'e wa'an sniwanil winh schekab' Dios aj Judá winh icham winak chi'. Ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh nok' sb'uru chi', ix yik'anb'at winh t'a schonhab' chi', yik tz'och winh t'a kusk'olal yuj, yik smukanpax winh.
Ha b'aj ijan ix mukji winh icham chi', hata' ix yak'och sniwanil winh schekab' Dios chi' winh. Ix te kus winh yet' heb' winh yuninal, ix yalan heb': Ay, ach kuk'tak, ob'iltak ach, xchi heb' winh.

Ayik toxo ix lajwi yak'ankanoch sniwanil winh chi' winh icham chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' yuninal chi': --Ayik ol in chamok, ol eyak'och in niwanil b'aj ix ochkan sniwanil winh schekab' Dios tik, junnhej tzeyutejkanoch in niwanil tik yet'ok.
Yujto yowalil ol elk'och tas ix schek Jehová yal winh t'a jun altar t'a Betel tik yet' t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh ay t'a yol yik Samaria tik, haton b'aj syak'em sb'a heb' anima, xchi winh.

Wach'chom ix uji juntzanh chi', palta a winhaj rey Jeroboam chi', maj yaktejkan masanil schuk b'eyb'al winh, ix yak'nhejoch heb' komon anima winh sacerdoteal t'a juntzanh komon Dios t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh. Yalnhej mach snib'ej winh tz'och sacerdoteal, syak'nhejoch yopisio heb' winh t'a juntzanh lugar chi'.
Ichaton chi' ix aj yochnhej smul winhaj Jeroboam yet' heb' yinhtilal, yuj chi' ix satel heb' smasanil.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix ilya'an winhaj Abías yuninal winhaj Jeroboam.

Ix yalan winhaj Jeroboam chi' t'a ix yetb'eyum icha tik: --Ha tiknaik ixik t'a Silo. Hata' kajan winhaj Ahías, winh schekab' Dios, haton winh aljinak to a in ol in ochkan reyal t'a jun chonhab' tik. K'exel a pichul yik wach' malaj mach ol na'anok to wetb'eyum ach.
Ik'b'at lajunheok ixim niwak pan yet' juntzanh ixim k'oxox pan yet' junok xalu yal chab'. Ixik, k'anb'ej t'a winh yik syalan winh t'ayach tas ol aj winh unin tik, xchi winh t'a ix.
Icha chi' ix yutej sb'a ix. Ix sk'exel spichul ix, ix b'at ix t'a Silo chi'. Ix k'och ix t'a spat winhaj Ahías chi'. Ha winhaj Ahías chi', maxtzak yal-laj yilan winh, te icham winakxo winh.

Palta toxo ix yal Jehová t'a winh to ol k'och ix yetb'eyum winhaj Jeroboam sk'anb'ej yuj jun yune' chuk sk'o'ol. Ix yalanpax Jehová t'a winh tas ol yutok winh yalan t'a ix. Ix ak'ji yojtakejel winh to ol sk'exel sb'a ix.
Ayik ix yab'an winh sk'anh sk'och ix t'a ti' pat, ix yalan winh: --Ach yetb'eyum winhaj Jeroboam, ochanh, ¿tas yuj ix a k'exel a b'a? Te kusk'olal tas ix chekji wal t'ayach.
Yuj chi' meltzajanh, al t'a winh etb'eyum chi' to a Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan t'a winh icha tik: Ix ach in sik'elta t'a skal heb' chonhab', ix ach wak'anoch yajalil t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ha in ix wik'ek' yopisio heb' yinhtilal winhaj David, ix wak'an t'ayach, palta manh ichok yutejnak sb'a winh in chekab' aj David chi' tzutej a b'a. Sk'anab'ajejnak in cheknab'il winh yet' smasanil sk'o'ol, a masanil tas sk'ulejnak winh, wach'nhej t'a wichanh.

Palta a hachxo pax tik, yelxo wal te chuk tas tza k'ulej t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' yajal ek'nak ayik mantzak ach ochi. Ha ach tik ix a tzuntzej wal kot wowal, ix a b'o juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en a diosalok, ix in a patikaneli.

Yuj chi' ol wak'kot ya'elal t'a yib'anh heb' inhtilal. Ol in satel masanil heb' winak t'a skal inhtilal t'a skal heb' israel tik, wach'chom chekab' yaji, ma yik sb'a, manhxa junok ol kanok. Pilan ol in satel inhtilal chi', icha tz'aj snhusjitz'a stza' nok' nok'.
Ha heb' ol cham t'a yol chonhab', a nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at heb'. Haxo heb' ol cham t'a spatiktakel chonhab' chi' jun, a nok' ostok ol chianb'at heb', xchi Jehová.
Ha hachxo pax tik ach ix, paxanh t'a a pat. Anhej yik ol ach ochk'och tek'naj t'a yol sti' a chonhab' ol cham winh unin chi'.

Haxo masanil heb' israel, ol kus heb' yuj winh, ol smukan winh heb', anhej wal jun yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam chi' ol mukjok, yujto anhej jun chi' wach'tak wal t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winh.
Hato yik b'ak'inh ol yak'anxioch Jehová junokxo rey t'a ko kal tik, ha' ol satanel masanil yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam t'a jun k'ual chi'.

Ol onh tzikub'tanhaj a onh israel onh tik yuj Jehová, icha wal tz'aj stzikub'tanhaj te' welek' yuj ha ha'. Ol onh ik'jokel t'a jun lum lum manh jantakok swach'il ak'b'il tik t'a heb' ko mam kicham. Ichato ol onh yumjokkanb'at t'a sk'axepalb'at ha' Éufrates, yujto ix ko b'o yechel jun komon Dios skuchan Asera. Yuj chi' sko tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a kib'anh.
Ha Jehová ol onh ak'anb'at t'a yol sk'ab' junxo nación yujnhej smul winhaj Jeroboam syak'och chi'. Ha winh skuchb'anb'at ko chonhab' tik t'a chukal, xchi winhaj Ahías chi' t'a ix.
Ixlajwi chi' ix pax ix yetb'eyum winhaj Jeroboam chi', ix k'och ix t'a Tirsa. Ha wal yochk'och ix t'a yol sti' spat, ix cham winh unin chi'.
Masanil heb' israel ix mukan winh, ix och heb' t'a kusk'olal yuj winh icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Ahías schekab'.
Ha juntzanhxo yab'ixal winhaj rey Jeroboam, ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' juntzanhxo tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yol stiempoal, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ha winhaj Jeroboam chi', 22 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh. Haxo yik ix cham winh, a jun winh yuninal winh skuchan Nadab ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Ha t'a Judá ix yak' reyal winhaj Roboam yuninal winhaj Salomón. 41 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'. 17 ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh t'a Jerusalén, haton wal jun chonhab' chi' ix sik'el Jehová t'a skal masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Israel yik tz'och ejmelal t'ay ta'. Naama sb'i ix snun winh, amonita ix.
Ha winhaj Roboam chi' yet' heb' aj Judá, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix ste tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová heb' t'a yichanh tas sk'ulejnak heb' smam yicham heb',
yujto ix laj sb'oxi juntzanh lugar cha'anh heb', haton b'aj tz'och heb' ejmelal yet' pax t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xi'il. Ix laj sb'oanpaxk'e k'e'en k'e'en heb' yechel komon Dios Asera.

Ay pax heb' winh winak ix k'ulan ajmulal yet' yetwinakil yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a skomon diosal chi'. Ix sb'eyb'alej ajmulal heb' te yajb'entak, icha sk'ulejnak heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yik'nakel Jehová t'a yichanh heb' israel chi'.
Ayik yoilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Roboam chi' reyal, ix jawi winhaj Sisac sreyal Egipto yak' owal t'a Jerusalén.
Ix yik'anb'at masanil b'eyumal winh ay t'a stemplo Jehová, masanil b'eyumal ay t'a spalacio winh rey yet' masanil juntzanh k'e'en maklab' jul-lab' nab'a oro b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj Salomón.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo k'e'en bronce ix schek b'ojok winhaj Roboam chi' sk'exulok juntzanh maklab' jul-lab' nab'a oro chi', ix yak'ankan winh t'a heb' yajalil heb' soldado ayoch stanhwumalok sti' spalacio winh.
Juntakel sb'at winh rey chi' t'a stemplo Jehová, a heb' soldado chi', syik'b'at k'e'en maklab' jul-lab' chi' heb', haxo smeltzajxi heb' syak'anxikan k'e'en heb' t'a yet'tal.
Ha yab'ixal juntzanhxo tas sk'ulejnak winhaj Roboam chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal masanil heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Aynhej owal t'a skal winhaj Roboam yet' winhaj Jeroboam.

Ayik ix cham winhaj Roboam chi', ix mukji winh b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Naama sb'i ix snun winh, amonita ix. Ixlajwi chi' haxo jun yuninal winh skuchan Abiam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 18 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat reyal t'a Israel, ix och winhaj Abiam reyal t'a Judá.
Oxe' ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh t'a Jerusalén. Maaca sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Abisalom.

Ha winhaj Abiam chi', ix sb'eyb'alej chukal winh icha ix sk'ulej winh smam winh. Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová sDiosal. Maj sk'anab'ajej Jehová winh t'a smasanil sk'o'ol icha sk'ulejnak winhaj rey David, haton winh smam icham winh.
Palta yujto xajan winhaj rey David chi' yuj Jehová, yuj chi' maj satkanel yinhtilal winh. Ixto ochkan yinhtilal winh chi' reyal t'a Jerusalén. Hanhejtona' ix skolkanel jun chonhab' chi' Jehová,

yujto te wach' yutejnak sb'a winhaj rey David chi' t'a yichanh. Manh yik'nakokel spensar winh t'a tas yalnak Jehová chi', anhej wal smul winh ochnak haton yuj tas ajnak smilan winhaj Urías hitita winh.

Ha winhaj Abiam chi', ix yak'nhej owal winh yet' winhaj Jeroboam chi', icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Roboam smam winh. Ha yab'ixal winhaj Abiam chi' yet' masanil tas sk'ulejnak winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj David, haxo jun winh yuninal winh skuchan Asa ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha winhaj Asa, ix schael yich winh yak'an reyal t'a Judá, a wal yik 20 ab'il yoch winhaj Jeroboam chi' reyal t'a Israel.
Ha winhaj Asa chi', 41 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Maaca sb'i ix snun chichim winh, yisil ix winhaj Abisalom.
Te wach' tas ix sk'ulej winhaj rey Asa chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal ix sk'ulej winhaj rey David smam icham winh.

Ix spechel masanil heb' winh winak winh t'a yol smakb'en chi', haton heb' winh sk'ulan ajmulal yet' yetwinakil t'a juntzanh lugar b'aj tz'och ejmelal. Masanil juntzanh yechel komon Dios ix sb'o heb' smam yicham winh, ix laj satpaxel winh.

Ix yik'el sniwanil yelk'och ix snun chichim winh, haton ix Maaca. Ix schekpax winh mak'jokpoj jun yechel Asera yajb'entak yak'nak b'o ix snun chichim chi', ix schekan nhusjoktz'a winh t'a sti' ha' Cedrón.
Wach'chom maj yik'el winh masanil juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh, palta te wach' ix yutej spensar winh t'a yichanh Jehová t'a masanil tiempo.
Ix yak'anpaxkanoch k'e'en oro winh yet' k'e'en plata b'aj sik'chajkan tas tz'ak'ji yikok Jehová yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' ix yak'kan winh smam winh yet' pax juntzanh ix sb'o winh.
Aynhej owal t'a skal winhaj Asa sreyal Judá yet' winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel.
Ix kot winhaj Baasa yak' owal t'a Judá, ix och ijan winh sb'o'an scuartel t'a chonhab' Ramá, yik smakan b'e winh yik wach' manhxa mach syal sk'och t'a Judá chi'.

Yuj chi', haxo winhaj Asa chi' ix ik'anelta masanil k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata sik'b'iltokan t'a yol stemplo Jehová yet' t'a spalacio winh. Ix schekanb'at heb' ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh yik sb'at yak'ankan k'e'en chi' heb' t'a winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria kajan t'a Damasco, haton winh yuninal winhaj Tabrimón, yixchikin winhaj Hezión. Ha yet' k'e'en tumin chi', ix yalanb'at winh t'a winhaj Ben-adad chi' icha tik:

Ko b'o junok ko trato, icha sk'ulejnak heb' ko mam kicham. Tik swak'b'at k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata in silab'ok t'ayach. Ak' lajwok a trato yet' winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel yik ol yaktej winh yak'an owal wet'ok, xchib'at winhaj Asa chi'.

Ix scha sk'ol winhaj Ben-adad chi' tas ix yalb'at winhaj rey Asa chi', yuj chi' ix schekkot heb' soldado winh yak' owal t'a yol yik Israel. Haton juntzanh chonhab' tik ix yak' ganar heb' soldado winh chi': Ijón, Dan, Abel-bet-maaca yet' masanil Cineret yet' masanil smakb'en Neftalí.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Baasa icha chi', ix yaktan winh sb'oank'e chonhab' Ramá, ix meltzaj winh t'a chonhab' Tirsa.

Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej masanil heb' winh aj Judá winhaj rey Asa chi', manhxa junok mach maj k'ochok. Ix yik'ankot jantak k'e'en k'e'en heb' yet' te te', haton juntzanh chi' wan yak'anoch winhaj Baasa yik sb'oank'e chonhab' Ramá chi'. Haxo yet' juntzanh chi' ix sb'ok'e scuartel winhaj rey Asa chi' t'a chonhab' Geba t'a yol yik Benjamín yet' t'a chonhab' Mizpa.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Asa, juntzanh owal ix yak' ganar winh, masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh yet' juntzanh chonhab' ix sb'ok'e winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá. Haxo yik ichamxo winh, ix och jun yab'il t'a yok winh.
Ayik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj rey David b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham. Haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Josafat ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik schab'ilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Nadab yuninal winhaj Jeroboam yak'an reyal t'a Israel, chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha sb'eyb'al winh smam winh ix sb'eyb'alej, haton winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' israel t'a chukal.

Palta haxo winhaj Baasa yuninal winhaj Ahías yinhtilal Isacar ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Nadab chi'. Ayik ix yak'an owal winhaj Nadab yet' heb' soldado Israel t'a chonhab' Gibetón, t'a yol yik heb' filisteo, hata' ix miljicham winh yuj winhaj Baasa chi'. Yuj chi' ayik yoxilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Baasa chi' yak'an reyal t'a chonhab' Israel.

Anhej wal yik ix och winh reyal chi', ix smilancham masanil yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam chi' winh, pilan ix cham heb' yuj winh, manhxa junok heb' ix kani, icha yalnakkan winhaj Ahías schekab' Jehová aj Silo.
Ix uji jun tik yuj smul winhaj Jeroboam ix yak'ochi ayik ix skuchb'anb'at heb' yetisraelal winh t'a chukal. Yuj chi' ix stzuntzajkot yowal sk'ol Jehová sDiosal chonhab' Israel yuj winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Nadab yet' masanil tas ix sk'ulej, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ix ochnhej owal t'a skal winhaj Asa sreyal Judá yet' winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel.
Ayik yoxilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Baasa yuninal winhaj Ahías yak'an reyal t'a Israel, t'a chonhab' Tirsa. 24 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh, te chuk t'a yichanh Jehová, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam, haton winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' israel t'a chukal.
Ixlajwi chi', ix lolon Jehová t'a winhaj Jehú, yuninal winhaj Hanani, yik b'at yalan winh t'a winhaj Baasa icha tik:

Te malaj elk'ochi, palta ach wik'cha'anh, ix ach wak'anoch yajalil t'a in chonhab' Israel tik, palta haxo sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam tza b'eyb'alej. Ix a kuchb'anb'at in chonhab' tik t'a chukal, yuj chi' ix he tzuntzejkot yowal in k'o'ol yuj he chukal chi'.
Yuj chi' ach Baasa, ol ach in satel yet' masanil inhtilal, icha ix wutej in satanel yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat.
Yalnhej mach heb' a k'ab' ok ol cham t'a yoltak chonhab', a nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at heb', haxo heb' ol cham t'a kaltak te', a nok' ostok ol chianb'at heb', xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Baasa chi' yet' jantak owal ix yak' ganar winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Tirsa, haxo jun winh yuninal winh skuchan Ela ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Jehú schekab', haton winh yuninal winhaj Hanani, tastak ya'elal ol jawok t'a yib'anh winhaj Baasa yet' heb' yinhtilal yet' sk'ab' yok, yujto te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová chi' winh, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam. Ix kotpax ya'elal t'a yib'anh winh yujto ix satel yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam chi' winh.
Ayik 26 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Ela yuninal winhaj Baasa yak'an reyal t'a Israel t'a chonhab' Tirsa. Chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh.

Ay jun winh Zimri sb'i, yajal winh t'a nanhal heb' soldado tzek' yet' carruaje yik owal, a winh ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Ela chi'. Ay jun k'ual ayek' winhaj Ela chi' t'a Tirsa, t'a spat winhaj Arsa, winh tz'ilan spalacio winh rey. Haxo ix aji, ix yuk' anh winh rey chi', ix k'e anh t'a sjolom winh.
Elanhchamel ix k'och winhaj Zimri chi', ix smilancham winh rey chi' winh, haxo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ix uji jun tik ayik 27 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá.
Anhej wal yik ix och winhaj Zimri chi' reyal, ix smilancham masanil yinhtilal winhaj Baasa chi' winh. Manhxa junok winak ix kani, manhxa pax junok sk'ab' yok winh, ma junok yamigo winh ix kani.
Icha wal chi' ix aj satel masanil yinhtilal winhaj Baasa chi', icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Jehú yuj winhaj Baasa chi'.

Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Baasa chi' yet' winhaj Ela yuninal winh, ix och smul heb' winh yuj skuchb'anb'at heb' israel yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová heb'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Ela chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.

Ayik 27 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Zimri yak'an reyal t'a Tirsa, palta ukenhej k'ual ix yak' reyal chi' winh. Ha t'a juntzanh k'ual chi' ayek' heb' soldado yik Israel yak' owal t'a Gibetón t'a yol yik heb' filisteo.
Haxo yik ix yab'an heb' soldado chi' to ix miljicham winh rey yuj winhaj Zimri, yuj chi' wal t'a jun k'u chi' ix yak'anoch winhaj Omri heb' sreyalok, haton winh yajalil heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yaktej winhaj Omri chi' yak'an owal yet' heb' soldado t'a Gibetón chi', haxo t'a chonhab' Tirsa ix k'och heb' yak' owal.
Haxo ix yilan winhaj Zimri chi' to wan yak'ji ganar jun chonhab' chi', ix och winh t'a yol scuartel t'a yol spalacio, ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al winh. Icha chi' ix aj scham winh.
Icha chi' ix aji yujto te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, to a wal sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, a ix sb'eyb'alej winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Zimri chi' yet' tas ix snacha'anh winh t'a spatik winhaj Ela, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ix spoj sb'a chonhab' Israel, cha poj ix aj heb': Jun makan heb', a winhaj Tibni yuninal winhaj Ginat snib'ej heb' tz'och reyal. Haxo junxo makan heb', ix kan heb' yet' winhaj Omri.

Haxo ix aji, a heb' ix kan yet' winhaj Omri chi', más jelan heb' t'a yichanh heb' ix och yet' winhaj Tibni chi', yuj chi' ix miljicham winhaj Tibni chi' yuj heb', haxo winhaj Omri chi' ix ochkan reyal.
Ayik 31 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Omri chi' yak'an reyal t'a Israel. 12 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh, wake' ab'il ix ek' winh t'a Tirsa.

Ixlajwi chi' ix smanan jun lum tzalan winh t'a Samaria t'a winhaj Semer. Nanhal schab'il quintal k'e'en plata ix yak' winh stojolok lu'um. Haxo ta' ix sb'ok'e jun chonhab' winh, Samaria ix yak' winh sb'iej, yujto Semer sb'i winh b'aj ix sman lum lum chi' winh.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Omri chi', te chuk t'a yichanh Jehová, ek'b'al schukal t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh rey ek'nak.

Ix sb'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat winh, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, yuj chi' stzuntzejnakkot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová Dios heb'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Omri yet' tas ix sk'ulej yet' tastak ix yak' ganar winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Samaria, haxo jun winh yuninal winh skuchan Acab ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayxo 38 ab'il yoch winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá, ayik ix och winhaj Acab yuninal winhaj Omri reyal t'a Israel. 22 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a chonhab' Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, ek'b'al chukal ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh rey ek'nak.

Malaj yalan sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat t'a winh. Ek'b'al te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh chi', ix yik' ix Jezabel yisil winhaj Et-baal sreyal Sidón winh yetb'eyumok, ix ochpax winh ejmelal t'a jun komon Dios skuch Baal.
Ix sb'ok'e stemploal Baal chi' winh yet' jun altar t'a Samaria.

Ix sb'oanpaxk'e jun yechel komon Dios skuch Asera winh. Ix ste tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová sDiosal Israel winh, yujto ek'b'al chuk ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh sreyal Israel ek'nak.

Ayik ayoch winhaj Acab chi' reyal, haxo winhaj Hiel aj Betel ix b'oanxik'e chonhab' Jericó. Ayik ix yak'anxiem yich jun chonhab' chi' winh, ix cham jun sb'ab'el yuninal winh skuch Abiram. Haxo yik ix och spuertail, ix cham winhaj Segub slajwub' yuninal winh. Ix elk'och icha tas yalnakkan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun.

Ay jun winh schekab' Dios skuchan Elías aj Tisbe t'a yol yik Galaad. Ha winh ix halan t'a winhaj rey Acab icha tik: Ha in tik schekab' in Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, a wal t'a yichanh Jehová swalkan t'ayach to manhxo ol yak'laj nhab' t'a jaye' ab'il tik, malaj jab'ok yal ak'wal ol emok, masanto a in ol wal junelxo, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik:
--Elanh t'a tik, b'at k'ub'ejkanel a b'a t'a sch'olanil sti' ha' Querit, haton ha' sk'ochkan t'a ha' Jordán t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ha jun ha ha' chi' ol uk'ej, a inxo ol wal t'a nok' joj yik ol b'at nok' yak'kan a wa'el, xchi t'a winh.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Elías tas ix yal Jehová chi', ix b'at sk'ub'anel sb'a winh t'a sch'olanil sti' ha' Querit chi'.
Junjun k'inhib'alil yet' junjun yemk'ualil syik'anb'at swa'el winh nok' joj chi' yet' schib'ej, haxo jun ha ha' chi' syuk' winh.
Palta ix k'och stiempoal ix tup ha ha' chi' yujto maxtzak yak'laj nhab'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Elías chi':
--Elanh t'a tik, ixikkan t'a chonhab' Sarepta t'a yol yik Sidón, tzach kan ta' junok tiempoal. Toxo ix wal t'a jun ix ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum to a ix ol ak'an a wa'el, xchi t'a winh.

Ix el winhaj Elías chi', ix b'atkan winh t'a Sarepta chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a sti' chonhab', ix yilanb'at jun ix ix winh, chamnakxo yetb'eyum ix, wan smolan chab' te' b'olob' ix. Ix yawtankot ix winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamax el t'a a k'o'ol, b'at ik' junok waso ha' wuk'ej, xchi winh.
Wanxo sb'at ix yik'kot ha', ix awajxi winh t'a ix: --Tzin tewipax t'ayach to tzik'kot jab'ok pan in wa''a, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix: --Wal t'a yichanh Jehová a Diosal swala', malaj jab'ok ixim pan b'ob'il wu'uj, haxonhej wal jun b'ech jab' warina ya'ab'ilkan wuj t'a yol jun xalu yet' jab' waceite ay t'a yol yet'tal. Anhej ol in k'ochxok yet' chab' in b'olob' tik, ol in wach' b'oan jab' warina chi' in wa yet' tzun wune' tik, ol lajwok chi', ol ko tanhwan cham ko b'a yuj wejel, xchi ix.

Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a ix icha tik: --Manh ach xiwok. Ixik, b'at b'o ixim icha ix aj halan chi', palta to tza b'ab'laj b'oej junok wik t'a jab' harina chi', tzik'ankot t'ayin, slajwi chi' ol a b'oan ik ol a wa yet' winh unin chi'.

Yujto toxo ix yal Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik to manh ol lajwok jab' harina ayem t'a yol a xalu chi' yet' jab' aceite ayem t'a yol yet'tal chi', masanto yik ol yak'anxikot nhab' Jehová, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at ix sb'o icha ix aj yalan winh chi'. Jantaknhej tiempo ix yak' jun wejel chi', ix wa winh yet' ix yet' pax heb' ayek' yet' ix t'a spat chi'.
Maj lajwiel-laj jab' yarina ix chi' yet' jab' yaceite chi', icha ix aj yalan winhaj Elías chi' yuj Jehová.
Ix ek' jun pekti', ix ilya'an jun yune' ix chi'. Te ow ix aj jun sya'elal chi', ix chami.
Ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Ach schekab' Dios, ¿tas halan ik t'ayin? ¿Tom yuj snachajkot in mul yet' scham tzun wune' tik, yuj chi' ach jawi? xchi ix.
--Ik'kot winh une' chi' t'ayin, xchi winhaj Elías chi' t'a ix. Ix scha'anek' winh unin chi' winh t'a ix, ix yik'ank'e winh t'a yol scuarto, ix yak'anek' jichan winh t'a sat sch'at.
Wal chi' ix yalan winh t'a Jehová icha tik: Mamin Jehová in Diosal, ¿tas yuj tzak'kot kusk'olal t'a yib'anh ix ix tz'ak'an in posado tik, tza cha'an cham winh yune' ix tik? xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', oxel ix b'at lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi', ix yalan winh t'a Jehová: Mamin Jehová in Diosal, tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak'xi sk'inal winh unin tik, xchi winh.
Ix yab'an Jehová tas ix yal winh chi', ix jax sk'o'ol winh unin chi'.
Elanhchamel ix yik'emta winh unin chi' winh b'aj aykan ix snun chi', ix yak'anxi winh t'a ix, ix yalan winh: --Ilnab'i, toxo ix jax sk'o'ol winh une' tik, xchi winh.
Ix yalan ix t'a winh: --Ha tiknaik swak'och t'a in k'o'ol to yel schekab' ach ton Jehová Dios, a tas schek ala', tz'elnhejk'ochi, xchi ix.
Ix ek'b'at oxe' ab'il, ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: B'at ch'ox a b'a t'a winhaj Acab yujto ol wak'xib'at k 'inal nhab', xchi t'a winh.
Ix b'at winh sch'ox sb'a t'a winhaj rey Acab chi'. Ha t'a Samaria te ow yak'an wejel.

Ha winhaj Acab chi' ix awtan winhaj Abdías, winh ayoch yilumalok spalacio winh. Ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Konh, b'at ko say kila', tope ay b'aj ay ha ha' t'a yol ko makb'en tik, b'aj sko say jab'ok yanh nok' ko chej, yik manh ol cham nok' yuj wejel, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix spoj sb'a heb' winh, ch'okch'ok b'aj ix b'atkan junjun heb' winh. Ha winhaj Abdías chi', aynhej xiwk'olal winh t'a Jehová. Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, ayik ix schekan ix Jezabel yetb'eyum winhaj Acab chi' to smiljicham heb' winh schekab' Jehová, a winhaj Abdías chi' ix k'ub'anel 100 heb' winh schekab' Jehová chi'. Chab' makan ix aj heb' winh yuj winh, 50 tak ix aj heb' winh. Ix b'at winh sk'ub'ejel heb' winh t'a yol chab' k'e'en nhak'e'en, haxo winh sb'at ak'an tas swa heb' winh yet' tas syuk'ej heb' winh t'a jun pekti' chi'.

Ayik wan yek' winhaj Abdías sayoj yanh chej chi', ix schalaj sb'a winh yet' winhaj Elías chi'. Ayik ix yilanoch winhaj Elías chi' winh, ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan winh: --Mamin, ¿tok a ach tik Elías ach? xchi winh.
--I' a in toni. Ixik al t'a winhaj Acab to ayinek' t'a tik, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Abdías chi': --¿Tas in mul yuj chi' tzin ak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Acab yik tzin smilancham winh?

T'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal swal t'ayach to malaj junok nación b'aj maj ach sayjiek' yuj winh rey chi'. Ayik ix yalan heb' winh rey chi' to malaj ach ayach ek' t'a yol smakb'en heb' winh, ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' to syak' sti' heb' winh tato yel malaj ach ayach ek' ta'.
Haxo tiknaik tzalan t'ayin to sb'at wal t'a winh rey chi' to ayach ek' t'a tik.

Axom ol ajok, anhej yik tzin el t'a a tz'ey tik, haxo Yespíritu Dios ol ach ik'anb'atok. Ma chekel b'ajtom ol ach k'ochok, haxo yik ol in k'och wal t'a winhaj Acab chi', ol kot winh ach saya'. Tato manhxo ach ayok ek' t'a tik, axom in smilancham winh chi' u'uj. Ha in a chekab' in tik, yiktax kelem hinto aynhej in xiwk'olal t'a Jehová.

¿Tom manta mach tz'alan t'ayach tas ix aj in kolan heb' winh schekab' Jehová t'a ix Jezabel ayik wan smiljicham heb' winh yuj ix? Ix in k'ub'ejel 100 heb' winh t'a yol chab' k'e'en nhak'e'en, 50 tak ix wutej in k'ub'anel heb' winh, ix wak'an tas swa heb' winh yet' tas ix yuk'ej heb' winh.
Haxo tiknaik tzalani to sb'at wal t'a winh rey chi' to ayachek' t'a tik, axom in smilancham winh chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi': --Wal t'a yichanh Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil swal t'ayach, jun swak' serwil to ha t'a jun k'u tik yowalil tzin lolon yet' winhaj Acab chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Abdías chi' yal t'a winhaj rey Acab chi'. Haxo yik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Acab chi', ix kot winh scha winhaj Elías chi'.
Haxo yik ix ilchaj winhaj Elías chi' yuj winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Tom a ach wan ixtan chonhab' Israel tik? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi' t'a winh icha tik: Manhok in laj wan wixtan jun chonhab' tik, palta a ach yet' masanil heb' a k'ab' ok, yujto ix eyaktejkan scheknab'il Jehová. Haxo t'a komon Dios Baal tzex och ejmelal.

Ha tiknaik, chekb'at yik'umal heb' ketisraelal yet' 450 heb' winh schekab' Baal yet' pax 400 heb' winh schekab' ix Dios Asera, haton heb' winh tz'ak'ji wa yuj ix Jezabel. Ol in chalaj in b'a yet' heb' winh t'a jolom witz Carmelo, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix schekan winhaj Acab chi' molb'aj masanil heb' winh schekab' komon Dios Baal t'a yol smakb'en Israel t'a jolom witz Carmelo.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och winhaj Elías chi' t'a skal heb' anima chi' smasanil, ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --¿B'ak'inh wal ol eyaktejkan somsoman he pensar? Tato a Jehová to yel Dios toni, anhejokab' t'ay tzex och ejmelal. Tato a Baal chi' Dios pax jun, anhejokab' t'ay tzeyak'em he b'a, xchi winh. Haxo heb' anima chi' maj tak'woklaj heb'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Ha t'a skal masanil heb' winh schekab' Jehová, a inxonhej pitzan in, haxo pax heb' winh yik Baal, ay 450 heb' winh.

Yuj chi', ik'ekkot chawanhok nok' mam wakax, sik'lan heb' winh schekab' Baal chi' junok nok' yiko', skotak xikanb'at nok' heb' winh, syak'ank'e nok' heb' winh t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz, palta max yak'ochlaj sk'ak'al te' k'atzitz chi' heb' winh. Ha inxo ol in b'opax junxo nok' chi', ol wak'anpaxk'e nok' t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz, hanheja' malaj sk'ak'al ol wak'ochi.

Slajwi chi', ol awaj heb' winh t'a sdiosal chi', hanheja' in pax tik ol in awaj t'a Jehová in Diosal. Ha junok Dios ol ak'ankot k'ak' t'a yib'anh nok' silab' chi', haton jun chi' Dios t'a yel, xchi winh t'a heb'. --Te wach' ton ix aj a na'an chi', xchi heb' anima chi' smasanil.

Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a heb' winh schekab' Baal chi' icha tik: --Sik'ekel junok nok' mam wakax tik tze b'oan nok', a ex ol he b'ab'laj b'oej heyik chi' yujto tzijtum ex, palta manh eyak'ochlaj sk'ak'al. Slajwi chi' tzex awaj t'a he diosal chi', xchi winh.

Ix smilancham nok' yik heb' winh chi', ix sb'o'an nok' heb' winh. Ix syamanoch heb' winh yawaj t'a sdiosal chi' t'a k'inhib'alil, hanheja' yawaj heb' winh masanto ix och chimk'ualil, syalan heb' winh icha tik: Tak'wanh t'ayonh Baal, xchi heb' winh. Sk'e chennaj heb' winh, tzek' oyoyok heb' winh t'a spatik altar b'aj ayk'e silab' ix sb'o chi', malaj mach stak'wi t'a heb' winh.

Haxo yik ix och chimk'ualil, ix syamanoch winhaj Elías chi' sb'uchwaj t'a heb' winh: --Más cha'anh tzex awaji, yujto Dios jun, tekan ay tas wan sk'ulani, mato ayb'at chuljel, ma ay b'aj ayb'at schek sb'a, mato jun, waynak, pitzekel swayanh, xchi winh.
Ix ochxi ijan heb' winh yawaj cha'anh, ix laj spolan sb'a heb' winh t'a k'e'en kuchilub' yet' t'a k'e'en kotak lanza, ichataxon sb'eyb'al heb' winh, chik'takxonhej ix aj heb' winh.
Ix ek' chimk'ualil, hanheja' yel yaw heb' winh, sk'e chennaj heb' winh masanto ayik wan sk'och yorail tz'ak'ji silab' t'a Jehová t'a yemk'ualil. Palta malaj mach ix ab'an tas ix yal heb' winh chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a heb' anima chi': --Kotanhek t'a in tz'ey tik, xchi winh. Ix snitzanb'at sb'a masanil heb' anima chi' t'a stz'ey winh, ix syamanoch winh sb'oanxik'e jun altar yik Jehová jub'ileli.
Ix yik'ankot lajchawe' k'e'en k'e'en winh, yujto icha chi' sb'isul heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jacob, haton winh yalnak Jehová t'ay to Israel sb'iejkani.
Ix sb'o'an jun altar chi' winh t'a Jehová t'a k'e'en k'e'en chi', ix sjoyan jun sanja winh t'a spatiktak jun altar chi', chanhe' am galón ha' tz'em t'a yo'ol.
Ix sb'oank'e te' k'atzitz winh t'a yib'anh altar chi', ix skotak xikanb'at nok' wakax chi' winh, ix yak'ank'e nok' winh t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz chi'.

Ix yalan winh: --B'ut'ek chanheok ch'ub' t'a ha ha', tze tob'anb'at ha' t'a yib'anh nok' silab' chi' yet' t'a yib'anh te' sk'atzitzal chi', xchi winh. Ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' to syik'kot ha' heb' t'a schaelal. Ix yik'anxikot ha' heb'. Ix yalanxi winh to syik'xikot ha' heb' t'a yoxelal, ix sb'o'an heb' icha tas ix yal winh chi'.
Ix el yok ha' t'a spatiktak altar chi', masanto ix b'ut'jikan jun sanja chi'.

Ayik ix k'och yorail ichataxon yik tz'ak'ji silab' t'a yemk'ualil, ix snitzanoch sb'a winhaj Elías chi' t'a stz'ey altar chi', ix yalan winh: Mamin Jehová sDiosal ach winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Israel. Ha tiknaik ojtakajokab'eli to a ach ton ko Diosal ach a onh israel onh tik, a inxo tik to a chekab' in, a ach ix a chek in k'ulej juntzanh tik.
Mamin Jehová, tak'wanh t'ayin, yik wach' ol yojtakejel juntzanh anima tik to a achnhej ton Dios ach, tzik'anxi meltzaj spensar heb' t'ayach, xchi winh.
Wal t'a jun rato chi' ix kot kopnaj k'ak' t'a satcha'anh yuj Jehová, ix tz'ab'at nok' silab' chi' yet' te' k'atzitz chi' yet' k'e'en k'e'en yet' lum pokok, ix tupb'atpax ha ha' t'a yol sanja chi'.
Ayik ix yilan heb' anima tas ix uji chi', ix sjulanek' telnaj sb'a heb' t'a sat lu'um, ix laj awaj cha'anh heb': Anhej Jehová yel Dios toni, xchixonhej heb'.

Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a heb': --Yamec heb' winh schekab' Baal tik. Malajokab' junok heb' winh tz'eli, xchi winh. Ix yamji heb' winh yuj heb' anima chi', ix schekan winh ik'chajb'at heb' winh t'a sti' ha' Cisón. Hata' ix miljicham heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Elías t'a winhaj Acab icha tik: --Ixik, b'at wa''anh, tzuk'an ha', yujto wan sk'anh sjawi jun niwan yaxnhab' swab'i, xchi winh.

Ix b'at winhaj Acab chi', ix wa winh, ix yuk'an ha' winh. Haxo winhaj Elías chi', ix k'ex winh t'a jolom witz Carmelo chi', ix em kuman winh ta' lesal, ix emk'och snanhal sat winh t'a skal sjolom spenek.

Ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' icha tik: --K'e'anh t'a jolom witz chi', tzach b'at k'elan t'a yib'anh ha' mar, xchi winh. Ix k'ek'och winh schekab' winh chi', ix yilanb'at winh t'a yib'anh ha' mar chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix jax winh t'a winhaj Elías chi', ix yalan winh: --Malaj jab'ok tas ix wila'', xchi winh. Ukel ix chekjib'at winh yil yuj winhaj Elías chi'.

Ayik ix lajwi xit'ek' winh t'a yukelal chi', ix yalan winh: --Ay wal tzin jab' asun t'a yib'anh ha' mar chi', smuslaj yuj junok ko k'ab', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ixik al t'a winhaj Acab to syak' lista nok' schej winh stok'an carruaje yik spax winh, tato ma'ay, majxo ta yal sk'och winh t'a spat yuj nhab', xchi winh.
Ix k'e winhaj Acab chi' t'a yol scarruaje yik sb'at t'a Jezreel. Wanto wal sb'at winh ix k'ik'b'iel satchanh yuj asun, ix kot ik' te ow, ix kot jun niwan yaxnhab'.

Haxo Jehová ix och yet' winhaj Elías chi', elanhchamel ix stok'cha'anh sjukan pichul winh, ix sch'apank'e winh t'a stzek'ul snanhal, ix b'at lemnaj winh. B'ab'el sb'at winh yuj winhaj Acab chi' masanto ix k'och winh t'a Jezreel.
Ix yalan winhaj Acab t'a ix Jezabel tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Elías yet' tas ix yutej winh smilancham heb' winh schekab' Baal.

Yuj chi', ix schekanb'at jun schekab' ix t'a winhaj Elías chi', ix yalanb'at ix icha tik: Aokab' heb' Dios tz'ak'ankot ya'elal t'a wib'anh tato manto ach cham wu'uj yab' icha tik k'ik'an, icha ix utej a milancham heb' winh schekab' in diosal chi', xchi ix.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Elías to ay smay jun chi', ix b'at winh elelal. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a Beerseba t'a yol yik Judá, hata' ix yaktejkan jun winh schekab' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a tzinan lu'um. Jun k'ual ix b'ey winh. Ix k'unb'i winh, ix em k'ojan winh t'a yich jun te' mes. Hata' ix snib'ej cham sb'a winh. Ix yalan winh: k'okb'ilxo tik Mamin. Ik'el in k 'inal, manh ek'b'aloklaj welk'och t'a heb' in mam wicham, xchi winh.
Ix ek' jichan winh t'a yich jun te te' chi', ix wayb'at winh. Haxo yik waynak winh chi', ix k'och jun ángel t'a winh, ix tenji winh yuj, ix yalani: K'e'anh wa'an, wa''anh, xchi t'a winh.
Haxo ix yilan winh t'a sjolomtak, ayek' jun ixim pan k'anb'inak t'a te' tzak'ak' yet' jun xalu ha ha'. Ix k'e k'ojan winh, ix wa winh, ix yuk'an ha' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix ek'xi jichan winh swayi.
Ix k'ochxi jun ángel chi' t'a winh, ix tenjixi winh yuj, ix yalani: K'e'anh wa'an, wa''anh, yujto te najatto skan b'aj ol ach k'ochok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix k'e wa'an winh, ix wa winh, ix te och yip winh yuj tas ix swa chi'. 40 k'u yet' 40 ak'wal ix b'ey winh, masanto ix k'och winh t'a lum witz Horeb b'aj sch'oxnak sb'a Jehová t'a heb' israel.
Ayik ix k'och winh ta', ix way winh t'a yol jun k'e'en nhak'e'en t'a jun ak'wal chi'. Ix lolon Jehová t'a winh, ix yalan icha tik: Elías, ¿tas tza k'ulej t'a tik? xchi.

Ix tak'wi winh t'ay icha tik: Mamin Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ix te kot wowal yuj tas tzach utaj yuj heb' wetisraelal. Yujto ix spatikejel a trato heb', ix sjuanem altar heb', ix xikancham heb' a chekab' heb'. Ha inxonhej ix in kolchajkaneli, palta wan in sayjiek' yuj heb' yik tzin smilancham heb', xchi winh.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh: Elanh t'a chi' tzach och linhan t'a wichanh t'a jolom witz tik, yujto ol in ek' ta', xchi t'a winh. Ix yak'ankot jun niwan ik' Jehová chi', ix laj pojb'at k'e'en tenam yuj, palta manh ayokochlaj t'a skal jun ik' chi'. Ixlajwi yek' jun ik' chi', ix yak'anpaxkot jun kixkab'. Palta hanheja' manh ayokochlaj t'a skal jun kixkab' chi'.

Ixlajwi yek' jun kixkab' chi', ix yak'anpaxkot jun k'ak', hanheja' malaj Jehová chi' ayoch t'a skal jun k'ak' chi'. Ayik ix lajwi yek'b'at jun k'ak' chi', ix yab'an jun lolonel winhaj Elías chi', te k'ununi ix aj yalani.

Ayik ix yab'an winh chi', ix smusan sat winh yet' jun spichul jukan, ix elta winh, ix aj linhan winh t'a sti' k'e'en nhak'e'en chi', ix yab'an jun lolonel chi' winh, ix yalani: Elías ¿tas tza k'ulej t'a tik? xchi.

Ix tak'wi winh: Mamin Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ix te kot wowal yuj tas ix ach utaj yuj heb' wetisraelal, yujto ix spatikejel a trato heb'. Ix sjuanem altar heb', ix xikancham heb' a chekab' heb'. Ha inxonhej ix in kolchajkaneli, palta wan in sayjiek' yuj heb' yik tzin smilancham heb', xchi winh.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: Ixik, meltzajanh t'a b'e b'aj ach koti, slajwi chi' tzach b'at t'a tzinan lum yik Damasco. Ayik ol ach k'och ta', tza sik'kanel winhaj Hazael yik ol och winh reyal t'a Siria.

Haxo winhaj Jehú yinhtilal winhaj Nimsi tza sik'paxkaneli yik ol och winh sreyalok Israel. Haxo winhaj Eliseo yuninal winhaj Safat aj Abel-mehola, tza sik'kanel winh yik ol och winh in chekab'ok a k'exulok.
Ha tas ol ujok, a mach ol kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Hazael, haxo winhaj Jehú ol milanchamok. Haxo mach ol kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Jehú chi', haxo pax winhaj Eliseo ol milanchamok.
Palta ayto uke' mil heb' israel chi' sik'b'ilkanel wu'uj, maj ochlaj heb' ejmelal t'a Baal, maj stz'ub'pax eltalaj heb', xchi Jehová chi'.

Ix meltzaj winhaj Elías chi' t'a jun lugar chi', ix ja winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Eliseo yuninal winhaj Safat. Wan st'okwi lum winh yet' lajchawe' mojanh nok' mam wakax. Ha winh et'jinak nok' tzak'anto sb'ati. Ix k'och winhaj Elías chi' t'a stz'ey winh, ix yak'anb'at jun sjukan pichul winhaj Elías chi' t'a yib'anh winh.

T'a jun rato chi' ix yaktankan nok' wakax winhaj Eliseo chi', ix och tzak'an winh yuj winhaj Elías chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Cha in b'ati, b'at walkan kilkob'a t'a in mam in nun, tzin tz'ub'ankanelta sti' heb' yik tzin pukankan in b'a yet' heb'. Slajwi chi', tzin och tzak'an u'uj, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'. --Syal a b'ati, manh wanok ach wak'an pural, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.

Ix b'at winhaj Eliseo chi', ix smilan chawanh nok' wakax chi' winh. Haxo yet' te' yugo ayoch t'a nok' ix sb'ol schib'ejal nok' winh, ix yak'an wa heb' anima smunlaj yet' winh chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix och tzak'an winh yuj winhaj Elías chi'.

Ha winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria, ix smolb'ej masanil heb' soldado winh. Ay pax 32 heb' winh rey junnhej ix yutej sb'a yet' winh yet' pax schej heb' winh yet' scarruaje heb' winh yik owal. Ix jawi heb' winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Samaria, ix och hoyan heb' winh t'a spatik jun chonhab' chi'.
Ix yak'ankot schekab' heb' winh t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Ha winhaj Ben-adad ix onh chekankot ul kala':
Wik yaj masanil a b'eyumal, heb' ix etb'eyum te wach' yet' heb' uninal te wach', xchikot winh, xchi heb' chekab' chi'.
Ix yalanb'at winhaj Acab chi' t'a winh icha tik: Mamin rey, ujokab' icha ix al chi'. Ha in tik yet' masanil tastak ay t'ayin ikokab'i, xchib'at winh.

Ix jaxpax heb' chekab' chi' t'a winhaj Acab chi', ix yalanxi heb' icha tik: Icha tik ix yutej winhaj Ben-adad yalanxikoti: Toxo ix walb'at t'ayach to wik yaj masanil a b'eyumal, heb' ix etb'eyum yet' pax heb' uninal.

Hanhejtona' yab' icha tik k'ik'an, swak'anb'at heb' yajalil heb' in soldado yik sb'at yilan heb' masanil tas ay t'a yol a palacio yet' yoltak spat heb' winh ayoch yajalil het'ok. Masanil tas ol snib'ej heb', ol yik'kot heb', xchi winh, xchi heb' chekab' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yawtankot masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' winhaj Acab chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': --¿Tas tz'aj he na'an a ex tik? Ha winhaj Ben-adad chi' wannhej sayan winh tas ol yutej onh yixtani, wach'chom a in tik toxo ix wal t'a winh to syal wak'an in b'eyumal, heb' ix wetb'eyum yet' heb' wuninal t'a winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan heb' ichamtak winak chi' yet' masanil heb' chonhab': --Mamin rey, manh a cha ab' tas syalkot winh chi' t'ayach, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Acab chi' t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Ben-adad chi': --Alek t'a winh rey wajal chi', ol in k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix yal winh t'a sb'ab'elal, palta haxo tas syalkot winh t'ayin tiknaik, manhxo ol in k'anab'ajejlaj, xchib'at winh. Icha chi' ix aj yalanxik'och heb' schekab' winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Ix schekanxikot heb' schekab' winh chi' junelxo t'a winhaj rey Acab chi', ix yalankot winh: Aokab' juntzanh Dios tz'ak'anoch in ya'elal tato max in satel Samaria chi' t'a junelnhej. Manh ol yab'laj sk'alemal yik syik'ankot jun jopok yik junjun heb' in soldado, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxib'at winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Ben-adad chi' icha tik: Manh smojok syik'cha'anh sb'a junok mach to wanto sb'at t'a owal, icha junok mach to wanxo sjaxi, xchib'at winh.

Wan yuk'an anh winhaj Ben-adad chi' yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh rey ayek' yet' winh t'a scampamento ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix yal heb' chekab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb' yajalil heb' soldado to syak' lista sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal yet' jun chonhab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yak'an lista sb'a heb'.

Yakb'an chi', ix jawi jun winh schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Acab chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Scham wal ilan jantak heb' ajk'ol chi', palta ol wak'och heb' t'a yol a k'ab' t'a jun k'u tik, yik wach' ol ojtakejeli to a inton Jehová Dios in, xchi Jehová, xchi winh chekab' chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab chi', ¿mach yuj ol ak'jokoch heb' t'a yol in k'ab' chi'? xchi winh. --Ha Jehová ix halani to a yuj heb' winh kelemtak skolwaj yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yoltak a makb'en tik, a yuj heb' winh ol ak' ganar, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'. --¿Palta mach ol b'ab'laj yamanoch owal chi'? xchi winhaj Acab chi'. --Ha extoni, xchi winh chekab' chi'.
Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej 232 heb' winh kelemtak chi' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix smolb'anpax heb' soldado winh ayek' ta', uke' mil heb' t'a smasanil.

Chimk'ualil wal ix el heb', b'ab'el sb'at heb' winh kelemtak chi' yuj heb', haxo winhaj Ben-adad yet' 32 heb' winh rey ajun yet'ok, hanheja' yuk'an anh heb' winh t'a yol scampamento. Ayik ix alji t'a winh yuj heb' soldado ayel yila' to ay juntzanh winak ix el t'a yol chonhab' Samaria,
ix yalan winh icha tik: Wach'chom t'a junk'olal ix elul heb', ma owal jun, yamek heb', pitzan heb' tzeyik'ankot heb' t'ayin t'a tik, xchi winh.
Ha heb' winh kelemtak skolwaj t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun chonhab' yik Israel chi', b'ab'el heb' winh, tzak'anoch masanil heb' soldado yuj heb' winh.

Junjun heb' ix milancham junjun heb' sirio ajk'ol chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' sirio chi' elelal, haxo heb' israel ix b'at t'a spatik heb'. Haxo winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix k'e winh t'a yib'anh schej yet' juntzanhxo heb' soldado, ix b'atkan heb' elelal.
Ix ak'ji ganar heb' sirio chi' yuj heb' israel chi', ix yik'ankan nok' chej heb' yet' carruaje yik owal. Te niwan heb' sirio chi' ix chami.

Ixlajwi chi' ix jax winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha tiknaik scham wal a na'ani tas tzutej ak'anoch stz'akub' heb' winh a soldado tik, yujto ha t'a junxo ab'il yab' icha tik, sjax heb' sirio tik yak' owal et' junelxo, xchi winh.

Hanheja' ix yalanpax heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado sirio chi' t'a winh sreyal chi' icha tik: --Ha juntzanh sdiosal heb' israel chi', sdiosal jolomtak witz. Yuj chi', ix onh yak' ganar heb'. Palta tato ha t'a panhkiltak skak' owal yet' heb', skak' ganar heb'.
Mamin rey, a tas tza k'ulej tiknaik to maxtzak ak'och heb' winh rey tik yajalilok heb' soldado, say sk'exul heb' winh.

Tzak'anpaxoch heb' soldado icha sb'isul heb' ix ak'ji ganar chi', lajan tz'aj sb'isul heb' yet' nok' chej yet' pax carruaje. Slajwi chi' tzonh b'at kak' owal yet' heb' israel t'a lum panhkiltak chi', ol kilan b'i'an tato manh ol kak' ganar heb', xchi heb'. Ix scha'an yab' winhaj Ben-adad tas ix yal heb' chi'.
Ayik ix ek' jun ab'il chi', ix yak'an lista heb' soldado winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix jawi heb' t'a chonhab' Afec yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel chi'.

Hanhejtona' ix yak'anpax lista sb'a heb' winh soldado israel chi', ix ak'ji syamk'ab' heb' yik sb'at heb' yak' owal yet' heb' sirio chi'. Ix b'at heb' israel chi', ix sb'oank'e scampamento heb' t'a yichanh heb' sirio chi'. Lajan wal yilji heb' icha chab'ok makte'al nok' chiwa, haxo pax heb' soldado yik heb' sirio chi' jun, majnakel sat lum ak'lik chi' yuj heb'.

Ha wal ta' ix jawi jun winh schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winh: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Yujto a heb' sirio tik ix halani to a in tik sDiosal in lum jolomtak witz, manh in sDiosalok lum panhkiltak, yuj chi' a tiknaik ol wak'och juntzanh tzijtumal anima tik t'a yol a k'ab', icha wal chi' ol aj ojtakaneli to a in ton Jehová Dios in, xchi Jehová, xchi winh chekab' chi'.

Uke' k'ual tonhej ix ajek' heb' soldado sirio t'a yichanh heb' soldado israel chi', ix lajwi chi' ix syamanoch heb' yak'an owal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' 100 mil soldado yik heb' sirio chi' sb'ey t'a yok ix cham yuj heb' israel chi'.

Haxo juntzanhxo heb' soldado chi', ix b'at heb' elelal t'a chonhab' Afec. Haxo smuroal jun chonhab' chi' ix kot lanhnaj t'a yib'anh heb', 27 mil heb' soldado ix el chi' ix chami. Ix pax lemnaj winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix k'och winh t'a jun chonhab' chi', tzuli tzek' winh sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yoltak pat.

Yuj chi' haxo heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh ix halan t'ay icha tik: --Ix kab'i to a heb' winh sreyal Israel ay yok'elk'olal heb' winh, yuj chi' komonok scha a k'o'ol skak'och pichul ya swa'i, skak'anoch lasu t'a ko jaj. Slajwi chi' b'at ko ch'oxan ko b'a t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', talaj tz'ok' sk'ol winh t'ayonh, manh ol onh smilchamlaj winh, xchi heb' t'a winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yak'anoch pichul heb' ya swa'i, ix yak'anoch lasu heb' t'a sjaj, ix b'at heb' sch'ox sb'a t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan heb': --Mamin rey, a winh a chekab' aj Ben-adad, tzonh schekkot winh kal t'ayach, komonok tz'ok' a k'o'ol max a milchamlaj winh, xchi heb'. Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Tom pitzanto winh jun? Ha t'a in sat, icha wuk'tak yaj winh, xchi winh.

Te wach' ix yal winh rey chi' ix yab' heb', yuj chi' ix yal heb' icha tik: --Mamin rey, a winh uk'tak aj Ben-adad chi' pitzanto winh, xchi heb'. --B'at ik'ekkot winh an, xchi winhaj Acab chi' t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix jawi winhaj Ben-adad chi' t'a yichanh winh, ix yak'ank'e winh winh t'a yol scarruaje.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Ben-adad chi' icha tik: --Ha tiknaik a juntzanh chonhab' yik'nak ek' winh in mam t'a winh a mam, swak'xikan t'ayach. Syal sb'at heb' a chonhwajum t'a Damasco icha sk'ulejnak heb' schonhwajum winh in mam chi' t'a Samaria, xchi winh. --Tato icha chi', ol ach wak'el t'a libre, xchi winhaj Acab chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sb'o'an jun strato heb' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix pax winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Palta ay jun winh t'a skal heb' winh schekab' Jehová, a Jehová ix halan t'a winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a jun winh yetb'eyum icha tik: --Ak' in echnaj in k'ana', xchi winh. Palta maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh yetb'eyum winh chi'.

Ix yalan winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Yujto maj a k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová, yuj chi' ayik ol ach el t'a in tz'ey tik, ay jun nok' choj ol ach milanchamok, xchi winh. Ayik ix el winh chi' t'a stz'ey winh schekab' Dios chi', haxo t'a yol b'e ix elta jun nok' choj t'a winh, ix miljicham winh yuj nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schalan sb'a winh schekab' Dios chi' yet' junxo winh winak, ix yalanxi winh t'a winh icha tik: Ak' in echnajok, xchi winh. Ha jun winh chi' ix mak'an winh schekab' Dios chi', ix lajwi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh schekab' Dios chi' smaklej winh rey t'a yol b'e. Ix sk'exanel sb'a winh, ix smusan sat winh t'a jun k'apak.

Ayik wan yek'b'at winh rey chi' ta', te cha'anh ix yal winh schekab' Dios chi': --Mamin rey, a in a chekab' in tik, ix in b'at t'a owal. Ha t'a skal heb' soldado ix elta jun winh soldado ix yik'ankot jun winh ajk'ol winh t'ayin. Ix yalan winh t'ayin to tzin tanhwej jun winh chi'. Ix cham wal yalan winh tato swaktejel winh ajk'ol chi', a inxo tzin cham sk'exulok winh, mato yowalil swak' oxeok arroba k'e'en plata.

Palta mamin rey, a in tik yakb'an ay jab'ok tas wan in k'ulani, ix el lemnaj winh ajk'ol chi' t'ayin, xchi winh t'a winhaj Acab chi'. Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi': --Munil a ach ix alk'eta a mul yet' tas ol elul t'a ib'anh yuj, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anel smusil sat winh schekab' Dios chi'. Haxo ix yilan winh rey chi' to a jun winh chi' a junok heb' winh schekab' Dios.

Ix yalan winh schekab' Dios chi': --Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Ha ach tik ix aktejb'at jun winh winak ix wala' to yowalil schami, yuj chi' a ach ol ach cham sk'exulok winh, haxo a chonhab' ol satel sk'exulok yik winh, xchi Jehová, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atkan winhaj Acab chi' t'a Samaria, ix chab'axk'e sk'o'ol winh. Wan schichon sk'o'ol winh ix ochkan winh t'a yol spalacio.

Ayik ix lajwi yek'kan juntzanh chi', a winhaj Acab rey t'a Samaria, ix snib'ej winh sman jab' slum jun winh aj Jezreel skuch Nabot. Ha jab' slum winh chi' awab'il te' uwa t'a sat, ha t'a stz'ey spalacio winh rey chi' ay. Ay jun k'ual ix yal winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Nabot chi' icha tik: --Ak' jab' a lum chi' t'ayin, yik hata' swawej jab'ok witaj, yujto t'a stz'ey in palacio ay. Haxo junokxo lum te wach' swak' sk'exulok, mato tzin tup t'ayach icha stojol, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Nabot chi' icha tik: --Max yal-laj, yujto max yal-laj sk'ol Dios to tzin chonhel in makb'en ak'b'ilkan yuj in mam wicham, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix pax winhaj Acab chi' t'a spalacio. Ix te och pitz'an t'a sk'o'ol winh, ix somchajcha'anh winh yuj tas ix yal winhaj Nabot chi'. Yuj chi' ayik ix k'och winh t'a spalacio chi', ix ek' jichan winh, ix meltzajkanoch k'elan winh t'a yich sch'at, majxo scha walaj sb'a winh.
Ix k'och ix Jezabel, ix yetb'eyum winh t'a stz'ey, ix sk'anb'an ix: --¿Tas yuj schichon a k'o'ol, max yal a k'ol tzach wa'i? xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi winh: --Yujto ix in lolon yet' winhaj Nabot aj Jezreel yuj jab' slu'um winh b'aj ay te' uwa, ix in k'an in man t'a winh, mato swak' junokxo lum sk'exulok, palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix yak' lum t'ayin, yuj chi' schichon in k'o'ol, xchi winh t'a ix.

Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj stak a k'ol yuj jun chi'? ¿Tom manh sreyalok Israel aj jun? Manh ak' pensar yuj jun chi'. K'e'anh wa'an, wa''anh. Ha in ol wik'ek' jun lum chi', ol wak'an lum t'ayach, xchi ix.

Ixlajwi chi' ix sb'o'an jun ch'anh carta ix t'a sb'i winhaj Acab chi', haxo sello winh ix yak'och ix t'a ch'anh. Ix yak'anb'at ch'anh ix t'a heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' b'aj kajan winhaj Nabot chi'.
Ix yalan ix t'a ch'anh carta chi' icha tik: Tze molb'ej heb' anima yik tz'och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Tzeyak'em k'ojan winhaj Nabot t'a yichanh heb' anima chi' t'a junok lugar niwan yelk'ochi.

Tze sayan chawanhok winak chuk spensar stek'b'ej sb'a yalan t'a spatik winh icha tik: Ha ach tik, ix ach b'uchwaj t'a Dios yet' t'a winh rey, xchiokab' heb' t'a winh. Slajwi chi' tzeyik'anel winh t'a stiel chonhab', haxo ta' tze julk'enejcham winh, xchib'at ix.
Haxo heb' ichamtak winak chi', ix sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal ix aj yalanb'at ix Jezabel chi' t'a ch'anh scarta chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalankot heb' t'a ix Jezabel chi' to toxo ix cham winhaj Nabot chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an ix Jezabel chi', ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Acab chi': --Ha tiknaik b'at makkan ikok lum slu'um winhaj Nabot aj Jezreel, haton lum maj yal sk'o'ol winh ix schonh t'ayach, yujto toxo ix cham winh, xchi ix.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Acab chi' to toxo ix cham winhaj Nabot chi', ix b'at sb'oanoch sb'a winh t'a sat lu'um.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Elías aj Tisbe:
--Ixik b'at il winhaj Acab sreyal Samaria. Ha t'a Jezreel ayek' winh tiknaik t'a lum slu'um winhaj Nabot, haton lum ix yik'ek' winh t'a winh.

Tzalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Yujto ix a milcham winhaj Nabot, ix ik'anek' lum slu'um winh tik, yuj chi' a b'aj ix lek'jik'e schik'il winh yuj nok' tz'i', hanheja' pax ta' ol lek'jokk'e a chik'il a ach tik yuj nok', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh, xchi t'a winhaj Elías chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Ach ajk'o'ol, ix in ilchaj u'uj, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi': --Ach ilchaj toni, yujto ix a tek'b'ej a b'a a k'ulan tas te chuk t'a yichanh Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová: Ol wik'kot kusk'olal t'a ib'anh, ol satel masanil heb' winak t'a inhtilal yet' heb' winak niwak yelk'och t'a skal chonhab' Israel, ma heb' chekab' yaji.

Icha wal wutejnak in satanel heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Baasa yuninal winhaj Ahías, icha wal chi' ol wutej in satanel heb' inhtilal, yujto ix a tzuntzejkot yowal in k'o'ol yuj tas ix a k'ulej, ix a kuchb'anb'at heb' etisraelal t'a chukal, xchi Jehová.
Haxo pax yuj ix Jezabel, a Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at schib'ejal ix t'a Jezreel tik.

Ha heb' inhtilal ol cham heb' t'a yol chonhab', a nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at sniwanil heb'. Haxo heb' ol cham t'a spatikel chonhab' chi', a nok' ostok ol chianb'at heb', xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.
(Wal yel malaj junokxo rey ix yutej sb'a icha ix yutej sb'a winhaj Acab chi'. Ix kuchb'aj winh yuj ix Jezabel ix yetb'eyum, yik stek'b'an sb'a winh sk'ulan chukal t'a yichanh Jehová.

Te yajb'entak ix yutej sb'a winh ayik ix och winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Lajan wal ix yutej sb'a winh icha yutejnak sb'a heb' amorreo, haton heb' yik'nakel Jehová t'a yichanh chonhab' Israel.)

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Acab tas ix yal winhaj Elías chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh. Ix yak'anoch pichul winh te ya swa'i. Ix och winh t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Ix way winh yet' spichul ya swa chi'. Te kusnak winh tzek' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik:

¿Tzam ila' tas syutej winhaj Acab chi' yik'anem sb'a t'ayin? Yuj chi' manh ol wak'b'at jun ya'elal chi' t'a yib'anh winh. Hato yik ayoch junok yuninal winh reyal sk'exulok, hato ta' ol wak'b'ati, xchi t'a winh.
Oxe' ab'il malaj jab'ok owal t'a skal chonhab' Israel yet' heb' sirio.
Haxo ix el yoxil ab'il chi', ix k'och winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá lolonel yet' winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi'.

Ix yalan winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a masanil heb' ayoch yopisio yet'ok: --Ha ex tik eyojtak sik'lab'il to a chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, kiktaxon yaji. ¿Tas yuj max kik'ek' t'a winh sreyal Siria chi'? xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Josafat chi': --¿Mamax yal a k'ol tzach och wet'ok yik skak'an owal yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Josafat chi': --Ha in tik ol in b'at het'ok yet' masanil heb' in soldado yet' jantak nok' in chej yik owal.
Palta ayik manto och owal chi', ol ko k'anb'ej t'a Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix yawtankot 400 heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios winhaj Acab chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh: --¿Tzam yal ko yamanoch owal yet' chonhab' Ramot, mato ma'ay? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh icha tik: --Hak'ek owal chi'. Ha Dios Kajal ol ak'anoch t'a yol he k'ab', xchi heb' winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Josafat chi': --¿Mama wal junok winh schekab' Jehová t'a tik b'aj sko k'anb'ej? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a winh: --Ayto wal junxo winh syal slolon yet' Jehová, haton winhaj Micaías yuninal winhaj Imla. Palta malaj in gana swil winh, yujto malaj jab'ok tas wach' syal winh t'a wib'anh, chuknhej tas syal winh, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Josafat chi': --Manh al icha chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtan jun winh schekab' winhaj Acab chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Ixik t'a elanhchamel, b'at ik'kot winhaj Micaías yuninal winhaj Imla, xchi winh.

Ha winhaj rey Acab yet' winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá chi', ayoch spichul heb' winh yik sreyal yuj, ix em k'ojan heb' winh t'a juntzanh xila yik heb' winh rey t'a jun tek'lab' trigo t'a stiel spuertail chonhab' Samaria. Masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi', ix stz'ak yal heb' winh tas ol aj yak'an ganar heb' winh rey chi'.

Ha winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Quenaana, ix sb'o juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en winh, icha sch'a'ak nok' wakax ix aji, ix yalan winh: Icha wal tik ix aj yalan Jehová: Ha juntzanh yechel ch'a'ak wakax tik, a sch'oxanel ipalil b'aj ol ak' owal yet' masanil heb' sirio masanto ol satel heb', xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi', lajannhej syutej heb' winh yalan t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Ixik, ak' owal t'a chonhab' Ramot yujto a Jehová ol ak'anoch t'a yol a k'ab', xchi heb' winh.

Haxo winh schekab' winh rey ix b'at yik'kot winhaj Micaías chi', ix yal winh t'a winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Masanil heb' winh schekab' Dios wan yalani to wach' ol elk'och winh rey, yuj chi' alpax icha tz'aj yalan heb' winh chi' a ach tik, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --T'a yichanh Jehová swal t'ayach to a tas ol yal Jehová t'ayin, a ol wala', xchi winh.

Ix jawi winhaj Micaías chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Ha tiknaik ach Micaías, ¿tom smoj sko yamoch owal yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, mato ma'ay? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi': --Ixik, ol ak' ganar jun owal chi', yujto a Jehová ol ak'anoch jun chonhab' chi' t'a yol a k'ab', xchi winh. Palta tonhej ix yal winh icha chi'.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Tzijtum elxo swal t'ayach to a tas yel, a chi' tzal t'ayin t'a sb'i Jehová, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: Ix wila'', masanil heb' soldado ketisraelal sakleminak sb'atkan heb' t'a jolomtak witz icha nok' kalnel malaj stanhwumal. Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha juntzanh heb' soldado tik, malaj yilumal heb', meltzajokab' junjun heb' t'a spat t'a junk'olal, xchi, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Josafat chi': --Ina ton swal t'ayach to a jun winh tik malaj jab'ok tas wach' syal winh t'a wib'anh, anhej chukal syal winh, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Ab' wal slolonel Jehová. Ix wila'' to k'ojanem Jehová t'a yol sdespacho, haxo heb' yángel t'a satcha'anh oyanoch heb' t'a spatik yichanh.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: ¿Mach wal junok ex b'at he montejb'at winhaj Acab yik sb'at winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, yik hata' schamkan winh? xchi. Ch'okch'ok ix yutej heb' ángel chi' yalan t'ay.
Haxo ix aji, ay jun espíritu ix k'och t'a yichanh Jehová, ix yalan icha tik: Ol b'at in montejb'at winh, xchi. Ix yalan Jehová t'ay: ¿Tas ol utej b'at a montanb'at winh jun? xchi.

Ix yalan jun espíritu chi' icha tik: Ol in b'at wek sna' juntzanh heb' winh schekab' winhaj Acab chi' yik anhej esal lolonel ol yal heb' winh, xchi. Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová: Ixik ol yal uj icha tzal chi', xchi.

Yuj chi', a tiknaik a Jehová ix ak'anoch jun espíritu t'a heb' winh a chekab' tik yik anhej esal lolonel syal heb' winh t'ayach. Ha Jehová ix halani to icha chi' tz'aj a chami, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.

T'a wal jun rato chi' ix snitzankot sb'a winhaj Sedequías chi' t'a stz'ey winhaj Micaías chi', ix stz'itanb'at sat winhaj Micaías chi' winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha jun espíritu tz'esan ix kot t'a Jehová chi', ¿tas ix aj yel t'ayin, haxo t'ayach sloloni? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Olxo ab'i ayik ol ach ek' a k'ub'ejel a b'a t'a yoltak pat, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj rey Acab chi': --Yamec winhaj Micaías tik, tzeyik'anb'at winh t'a winhaj Amón sgobernadoral chonhab' tik yet' t'a winh wuninal aj Joás.

Tzeyalan t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha winh rey ix halani to tz'och jun winh tik t'a preso. Jab'nhej swa'el winh tzeyak'a', jab'nhej pax ha' tzeyak' yuk'ej winh, masanto tzin meltzaj t'a junk'olal, xchi winh rey chi', xe chi t'a heb' winh.

Ix yalan jay b'elanh lolonel tik winhaj Micaías chi': Tato tzach meltzaj t'a junk'olal, syalelk'ochi to manhok Jehová ix chekan wal juntzanh lolonel chi', xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' anima chi': --Ex wetchonhab', scham wal he na'an jun ix wal tik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi' yet' winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá. Ix k'och heb' winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad.

Ix yalan winhaj Acab t'a winhaj Josafat chi': --Ha in tik, ol in k'exel in pichul yik ol wak' owal chi', a hachxo tik, ayokab'nhej och a pichul yik reyal tik, xchi winh t'a winh. Ix sk'exanel spichul winh chi', ix och winh t'a skal owal chi'.
Haxo pax winh sreyal Siria, toxo ix yal winh t'a heb' 32 yajalil soldado yik carruaje: Manh eyak' owal yet' junokxo mach, palta anhej yet' winh sreyal Israel tzeyak' owal chi', xchi winh.
Ayik ix iljib'at winhaj Josafat yuj heb' yajalil soldado chi', a sna'an heb' to a winh sreyal Israel, ix yoyan sb'a heb' t'a spatik winh, yuj chi' ix el yaw winh.
Ix yab'an heb' soldado chi' to manhoklaj winh sreyal Israel chi', yuj chi' ix yaktej heb' spechan winh.

Palta ay jun soldado sirio ix komon julanb'at sjul-lab' t'a skal heb' soldado wan yak'an owal chi'. k'okb'il wal a winhaj rey Acab chi' ix yamchaji. Ha wal b'aj schalaj sb'a cha makan k'e'en pichul ayoch yuj winh, hata' ix och jun jul-lab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh yamjinak sch'anhal nok' chej tok'jinak carruaje b'aj ayk'e winh chi': --Ik' meltzaj nok' chej tik, tzin ik'anel t'a skal owal tik, yujto te niwan ix in aj in lajwi, xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi' te niwan jun owal ix yak' chi'. Ixto syamk'e linhan winhaj Acab chi' heb' t'a yol carruaje yik tzato wal yak' yip heb' yak'an owal yet' heb' aj Siria chi', ix k'e wal sib'an schik'il winh t'a yol carruaje chi', haxo yik ix em k'u ix cham winh.
Haxo yik wanxo sk'ik'b'i, ix och jun aw t'a skal masanil heb' soldado, ix yalani: Paxanhek t'a he chonhab', ma t'a he lu'um junjun ex, xchi.
Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Acab chi', ix ik'jikot sniwanil winh t'a Samaria. Ha t'a Samaria chi' ix mukji winh.

Ix b'ikjiel scarruaje winh chi' t'a jun tanque b'ob'il t'a Samaria chi', b'aj sb'ikel sb'a heb' ix aj mul ix. Hata' ix lek'ji schik'il winhaj Acab chi' yuj nok' tz'i'. Icha wal chi' ix aj yelk'och tas ix yal Jehová.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Acab chi' yet' tas ix sk'ulej winh yet' pax yab'ixal spalacio winh ayoch marfil yelwanub'ok yet' niwak chonhab' ix laj sb'o winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik ix cham winh, haxo winhaj Ocozías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik chanhexo ab'il yoch winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel, ix och winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá.
Ayxo 35 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi', 25 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Azuba sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Silhi.

Ha winhaj Josafat chi', wach'nhej ix yutej sb'eyb'al winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha yutejnak sb'a winhaj Asa smam winh. Anhej to maj scheklaj winh ik'jokel masanil yet'tal b'aj tz'och ejmelal b'aj syak' silab' heb' anima yet' b'aj snhus incienso heb' t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh.
Ix och winh t'a junk'olal yet' winh sreyal Israel.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winh yet' sb'inajnakil winh yet' b'ajtak ix yak' ganar owal winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Masanil juntzanh winak smulan yet' yetwinakil, ix laj spechel heb' winh t'a yol smakb'en, haton juntzanh heb' winh ixto kan t'a stiempoal winhaj Asa smam winh.
(Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', malaj rey ayoch t'a Edom, anhej jun winh yajal ak'b'iloch yuj winhaj Josafat.)

Ha winhaj Josafat chi', ix yak' b'ojok juntzanh te' barco winh icha te' yik heb' aj Tarsis, yik sb'at te' yik' k'e'en oro t'a Ofir, palta maj yal-laj sb'at te', yujto ix pojkanb'at te' t'a Ezión-geber.
Ha winhaj Ocozías yuninal winhaj Acab, ix snib'ej winh ix b'at heb' smunlajwum t'a te' barco yet' heb' yik winhaj Josafat chi', palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winhaj Josafat chi'.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Josafat chi', ix mukji sniwanil winh yet' heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Haxo winhaj Joram yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 17 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Josafat reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Ocozías yuninal winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel t'a chonhab' Samaria. Chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh.

Palta te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha sb'eyb'al smam snun winh ix sb'eyb'alej yet' pax sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, haton winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal.
Ix och winhaj Ocozías chi' ejmelal t'a komon Dios Baal, icha sk'ulejnak winh smam winh. Icha chi' ix aj stzuntzankot yowal sk'ol Jehová sDiosal Israel winh t'a yib'anh.
